display.text:
# Review Doctrine
Findings are hypotheses until challenged. Concrete observable failure beats generic concern. Tests are evidence, not truth. Security requires source -> trust transition -> insufficient control -> meaningful consequence. A clean scanner/test result never proves absence. Separate severity from confidence. Record rejected hypotheses that defend important behaviour. Do not report style nits.

display.text:
# Context Pack: `sprint-qa-investigation` — QA adversarial investigation Target: ultraplan-go @ 8eef70f4903b25580719960009a170945bdad9ad (frozen). Planning context: ultraplan-workspace @ ab12dc38059c9bf485f9aced9075bcd7d924cac5. Domain: governed-sprint-delivery. Risk: high. Descriptive only — no defect judgments. ## 1. Purpose Read-only, bounded adversarial QA over one sprint's changed paths. The surface decomposes execute-evidence changed paths into a byte-stable shard map, runs fenced read-only LLM "investigators" per shard under hard budgets (turns, retries, timeouts, output bytes), accepts only strictly decoded theory drafts with closed outcome enums, deterministically synthesizes outcomes/dedup/contradictions/follow-ups, and persists everything in a private `verification/` tree whose flow-state pointer is always written last. QA annotates; it never changes the Conformance Review verdict, promotes issues, or repairs code (cli-reference.md:346-361; ARCHITECTURE.md verification-boundary section). ## 2. Entrypoints and control flow ### 2.1 CLI (`sprint

qa`, sprint_commands.go:369-466) `parseSprintQAArgs` (sprint_commands.go:588) admits actions run(default)|map(`--dry-run`)|status|resume|cancel|recover plus `--shard `, `--run ` (cancel-only), `--json`. Dispatch: - **map**: `Service.QAMap` — pure; no runtime, no durable acceptance, no state write. - **status**: `QAStatus` — read-only projection of the pointer and its referenced records. - **recover**: `RecoverQA(ctx)` under the full mutation lease. - **cancel**: builds `dashboardUseCases` and calls `CancelQA` — run-control only; no sprint mutation lease is taken. - **run/resume**: `beginDurableCLICommand(OperationQAStart/QAResume)` (accept-before-execute), `durable.QAWriterToken()` mints token+fence from the accepted operation context (durable_operations.go:64-69,140-156), then `sprintRuntimeService(...).WithQAWriterFence(fence).RunQA(durable.Context(), …)`. Afterwards `QAStatus` is re-read for the result projection; `finishDurableCLICommand` proposes the run terminal. All actions append the review-status projection via `withQAConformanceReview` (sprint_usecases.go:747-758, `WithoutStatusWrites`) and render through `renderSprintQA`/JSON envelope with `mapQACommandError` exit mapping (sprint_commands.go:662-679: canceled/deadline→8, runtime/persistence→6, other QA categories→5). ### 2.2 TUI/web runtime path `sharedOperationRunner` case OperationQAStart/QAResume (operation_runner.go:114-130): `qaOwnershipFromContext(ctx)` extracts the ownership value stored by `AcceptOperation` (durable_operations.go:130-131); fence closure heartbeats the outer run-control lease on every check via `repository.Heartbeat` under `context.WithoutCancel`+30s (durable_operations.go:146-154). Web/TUI read projections: `dashboardUseCases.QAStatus/QAShard/QATheory/QASynthesis` (sprint_usecases.go:626-693). Web/TUI cancel: `CancelQA` validates run ownership (project/sprint/kind ∈ {qa-start,qa-resume}) before `runs.CancelRun(…, "read-only QA cancellation requested")` (sprint_usecases.go:716-737). Operation-request admission restricts QA kinds to project/sprint/shard-only fields (`validateQAOperationRequest`, operations.go:594-611) and lists prerequisites "complete execute evidence", "current Conformance Review", "approved read-only target" (operations.go:597). ### 2.3 QAMap → BuildQAMap (qa_map.go:43-137, 139-277) Pure map construction: settings validation → `PrepareReview(ReviewRequest{})` must return zero findings → `LoadFlowState` gate: `flow.Review` non-nil, non-stale, fingerprint set, Status ∈ {Completed, Blocked} (terminal) → changed paths = `normalizeQAStrings(manifest.ChangedPaths)`, rejecting empty or single "(…)" placeholders ("execute evidence does not enumerate changed paths") → `targetIdentity(manifest.Target)` as implementation fingerprint → input refs from manifest input hashes (missing ⇒ stale) plus review.md digest when recorded → governed/policy/check-catalog fingerprints are sha256 over canonical JSON (fingerprintQAValue) → adjacent-context pairing `.go`↔`_test.go` by os.Stat → expectation refs from coverage IDs else `["governed-plan"]` → git identity (HEAD, hashed cached diff, hashed status --short) → approved-check catalog. `BuildQAMap` groups paths by `qaBehaviorGroup` (extension allowlist .go/.md/.html/.js/.css/.yml/.yaml/.json/.sh/.sql; keys internal/, cmd/, root/, or top dir), sorts groups, chunks per ChangedPathsPerShard, pre-blocks unclassified paths (Phase blocked + blocker, no silent omission), adds one boundary shard when >1 primary (overlap = first changed path of each primary, capped at ContextPathsPerShard), enforces PrimaryShards/TotalShards/PendingEntries budgets, sorts shards by content-derived ID, and enforces exactly-one-primary-owner per changed path in `ValidateQAMap`. `NormalizedQAMapBytes` (MarshalIndent+\n) is the byte-stable form. ### 2.4 RunQA (qa.go:237-360) Ordering: require runtime + valid token + valid settings → wrap progress with `boundedQAProgress` (RecentProgress cap, mutex) → `acquireMutationContext` (in-process sync.Map + pidfile lease held for the whole run) → writer-fence fallback comparator if no real fence installed (qa.go:258-267) → store with fence → `PruneAttempts("")` retention sweep → `VerificationBytes()` ≤ StateBytes else budget-exhausted → `QAMap` rebuild → second `PrepareReview` (findings ⇒ StaleInput) → `LoadFlowState` → `prepareQAAttempt`: - **Resume** (req.Resume ∧ prior.CurrentAttemptID == current SemanticAttemptID ∧ prior.Map != nil): retained Completed/Blocked shards reloaded from disk; run correlation reset to the NEW token (Claimed), phase queued, blocker/cancellation cleared, published. - Otherwise fresh: phase mapped, Map+Shards+State published together, state reloaded, prune protecting the current attempt. A resume whose prior attempt ID mismatches silently falls through to this fresh path. Then phase running published (state only) → `runQAShardBatch` #1 → on error `terminalQAState`+publish+return; else synthesizing publish → pure `SynthesizeQA(map, shards)` → if follow-up shards proposed: append them (TotalShards grows), run batch #2, re-synthesize → `hydrateQASynthesisFollowUps` requires every follow-up to have reached retained terminal Completed/Blocked → final publish (all Shards + Synthesis + completed State) → reload state → emit complete. ### 2.5 Shard execution (qa.go:428-666) Batch skips already-terminal shards unless FocusShard selects one (unknown/terminal focus ⇒ InvalidState). Workers = min(ConcurrentInvestigators, pending); jobs/results channels; a publication failure closes `abortResults` and cancels the batch context while draining results; per-result shard phase mapping: Canceled→cancelled, DeadlineExceeded→interrupted, other errors→blocked (+blocker); state republished after EACH terminal shard. `runOneQAShardSafely` recovers panics into RuntimeUnavailable blockers. `runOneQAShard`: `validateCurrentQAMap` (installed qaMapFence, else full deterministic map rebuild comparing map IDs) → investigator request built from `RenderQAInvestigatorPrompt` (packet JSON embedded; PromptBytes cap) with Sandbox=read_only, Permissions=restricted, RequireCaps=[permissions], tool policy default deny {read,list,search,glob allow}, PathRules allow-listing contained changed+context paths, Timeout=ShardTimeout, metadata operation/task/operational_attempt → retry loop ≤ RuntimeRetries+1: targetIdentity before-run must equal map fingerprint (else StaleInput); StartRun; identity after-run drift ⇒ PermissionDenied; map revalidated (governed-input drift ⇒ StaleInput); result.Permissions must be restricted/deny/0-unsupported else PermissionDenied fail-closed; success path enforces Turns ≤ IterationsPerAttempt else BudgetExhausted; failure classification (`classifyQARuntimeFailure`): canceled/deadline return immediately; result.Error.Category ∈ {validation,invalid_input,permission_denied,configuration,unsupported} non-retryable; unknown categories retryable until the bound. Then `decodeQAInvestigatorOutput`: TerminalOutput or last event payload["content"], size ∈ (0, ShardOutputBytes], strict single JSON object, DisallowUnknownFields, schema_version==1 → output-count budgets vs TheoriesPerShard/ContextExpansions/CommandsPerAttempt → context requests: self-approval (Approved=true) rejected PermissionDenied, path count ≤ PathsPerExpansion, each path validateQA... (line truncated to 2000 chars) ### 2.6 Approved-check policy (qa_prompt.go:59-134, 243-285) Catalog today is a single descriptor `go-format-diff` (gofmt -d ) when any changed path ends .go; cwd pinned to target root; timeout/output limits from budgets. `validateQACheckDescriptor` bans interpreters/shells/git (lowercased basename blocklist), shell/redirection metacharacters in args, `-w`/`--write*` flags, arg paths that are absolute or escape the target, and env names outside {LANG, LC_ALL, TZ}. Descriptor fingerprint covers all fields except the fingerprint itself. ### 2.7 Synthesis (qa_synthesis.go) Pure over validated inputs; rejects shards from another semantic attempt. Sort-normalizes shards/theories/challenges; challenge count ≤ FollowUpShards, each must reference known theory IDs and carry the map ID. Equivalence key = lower(join(claim, verification_surface, sorted expectation refs)) drives dedup (first ID retains the rest) and contradiction detection (confirmed ∧ refuted in one group). Interactions pair cross-shard theories or pairs sharing risk tags. Follow-up candidates = cross_shard/inconclusive theories capped at FollowUpShards; each becomes a follow_up shard with parent-theory link and deterministic ID. 233: 		state.NextAction = "Run qa --dry-run, then start a new QA attempt from the current map."
234: 	}
235: 	if !changed {
236: 		return s.QAStatus(projectRef, sprintRef)
237: 	}
238: 	state.UpdatedAt = now
239: 	if err := store.SaveRecoveredState(state, flow); err != nil {
240: 		return QASnapshot{}, err
241: 	}
242: 	settings, settingsErr := s.effectiveQASettings()
243: 	if settingsErr == nil {
244: 		if err := store.PruneAttempts(state.CurrentAttemptID, settings.Budgets.RetainedAttempts); err != nil {
245: 			return QASnapshot{}, err
246: 		}
247: 	}
248: 	return s.QAStatus(projectRef, sprintRef)
249: }

278: // RunQA owns one bounded read-only investigation attempt. Mapping stays pure;
279: // this method starts persistence and runtimes only after a valid writer token
280: // and the sprint mutation lease have both been acquired.
281: func (s Service) RunQA(ctx context.Context, projectRef, sprintRef string, req QARunRequest) (QARunResult, error) {
282: 	if req.Suite != "" {
283: 		if req.Suite != "smoke" {
284: 			return QARunResult{}, NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "run", "unsupported QA suite", nil)
285: 		}
286: 		if req.Resume || req.FocusShard != "" {
287: 			return QARunResult{}, NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "run", "the smoke QA suite cannot resume or focus a shard", nil)
288: 		}
289: 		if err := req.WriterToken.Validate(); err != nil {
290: 			return QARunResult{}, NewQAError(QAErrorConflict, "run", err.Error(), err)
291: 		}
292: 		smoke, smokeErr := s.RunSmoke(ctx, projectRef, sprintRef, SmokeRequest{Progress: func(progress SmokeProgress) {
293: 			emitQA(req.Progress, QAProgress{Phase: QAPhaseRunning, Event: "smoke_" + string(progress.Phase), Message: progress.Message})
294: 		}})
295: 		phase, terminal := QAPhaseCompleted, QATerminalCompleted
296: 		next := smoke.NextAction
297: 		if smokeErr != nil || smoke.Status != SmokeCompleted || smoke.Verdict == SmokeFailVerdict || smoke.Verdict == SmokeBlockedVerdict {
298: 			phase, terminal = QAPhaseBlocked, QATerminalBlocked
299: 		}
300: 		state := QAState{SchemaVersion: QASchemaVersion, Project: projectRef, Sprint: sprintRef, Phase: phase, Freshness: QAFreshness{Current: smokeErr == nil && !smoke.Stale}, Run: qaRunCorrelation(req.WriterToken, QARunTerminal), NextAction: next, UpdatedAt: s.now().UTC()}
301: 		state.Run.TerminalResult = terminal
302: 		return QARunResult{Project: projectRef, Sprint: sprintRef, State: state, Smoke: &smoke}, smokeErr
303: 	}
304: 	if s.runtime == nil {
305: 		return QARunResult{}, NewQAError(QAErrorRuntimeUnavailable, "run", "a QA runtime is required", nil)
306: 	}
307: 	if err := req.WriterToken.Validate(); err != nil {
308: 		return QARunResult{}, NewQAError(QAErrorConflict, "run", err.Error(), err)
309: 	}
310: 	settings, err := s.effectiveQASettings()
311: 	if err != nil {
312: 		return QARunResult{}, NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "run", "effective QA settings are invalid", err)
313: 	}
314: 	req.Progress = boundedQAProgress(req.Progress, settings.Budgets.RecentProgress)
315: 	lockedCtx, release, err := s.acquireMutationContext(ctx, projectRef, sprintRef)
316: 	if err != nil {
317: 		return QARunResult{}, err
318: 	}
319: 	defer release()
320: 	sp, err := s.resolveMutationSprint(projectRef, sprintRef)
321: 	if err != nil {
322: 		return QARunResult{}, err
323: 	}
324: 	fence := s.qaWriterFence
325: 	if fence == nil {
326: 		expected := req.WriterToken
327: 		fence = func(got QAWriterToken) error {
328: 			if got != expected {
329: 				return errors.New("writer token does not own this QA invocation")
330: 			}
331: 			return nil
332: 		}
333: 	}
334: 	store := NewQAStore(s.root, sp).WithWriterFence(fence)
335: 	if err := store.PruneAttempts("", settings.Budgets.RetainedAttempts); err != nil {
336: 		return QARunResult{}, err
337: 	}
338: 	if used, sizeErr := store.VerificationBytes(); sizeErr != nil {
339: 		return QARunResult{}, sizeErr
340: 	} else if used > int64(settings.Budgets.StateBytes) {
341: 		return QARunResult{}, NewQAError(QAErrorBudgetExhausted, "run", "retained QA state exceeds the configured state budget", nil)
342: 	}
343: 	mapResult, err := s.QAMap(projectRef, sprintRef)
344: 	if err != nil {
345: 		return QARunResult{}, err
346: 	}
347: 	manifest, findings, err := s.PrepareReview(projectRef, sprintRef, ReviewRequest{})
348: 	if err != nil || len(findings) > 0 {
349: 		return QARunResult{}, NewQAError(QAErrorStaleInput, "run", "cannot resolve the current governed target", err)
350: 	}
351: 	flow, err := LoadFlowState(s.root, sp)
352: 	if err != nil {
353: 		return QARunResult{}, NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "run", "flow state is unavailable", err)
354: 	}
355: 	state, shards, err := s.prepareQAAttempt(store, flow, mapResult.Map, req, settings)
356: 	if err != nil {
357: 		return QARunResult{}, err
358: 	}
359: 	emitQA(req.Progress, QAProgress{Phase: QAPhaseQueued, Event: "shards_queued", Completed: state.CompletedShards, Total: state.TotalShards, Message: "QA shards queued"})
360: 
361: 	runCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(lockedCtx, settings.Budgets.RunTimeout)
362: 	defer cancel()
363: 	state.Phase = QAPhaseRunning
364: 	state.Run.Lifecycle = QARunActive
365: 	state.NextAction = "Wait for the bounded read-only investigators."
366: 	state.UpdatedAt = s.now().UTC()
367: 	if err := store.Publish(QAPublication{State: state, Flow: flow}, req.WriterToken); err != nil {
368: 		return QARunResult{}, err
369: 	}
370: 	emitQA(req.Progress, QAProgress{Phase: QAPhaseRunning, Event: "investigation_started", Completed: state.CompletedShards, Total: state.TotalShards, Message: "QA investigation started"})
371: 	shards, state, runErr := s.runQAShardBatch(runCtx, store, flow, mapResult.Map, manifest.Target, shards, state, req)
372: 	if runErr != nil {
373: 		state = terminalQAState(state, runErr, s.now().UTC())
374: 		if publishErr := store.Publish(QAPublication{State: state, Flow: flow}, req.WriterToken); publishErr != nil {
375: 			return QARunResult{}, errors.Join(runErr, publishErr)
376: 		}
377: 		return QARunResult{Project: sp.Project, Sprint: sp.Slug, State: state, Map: mapResult.Map, Shards: shards}, runErr
378: 	}
379: 
380: 	state.Phase = QAPhaseSynthesizing
381: 	state.NextAction = "Synthesize the retained shard outcomes."
382: 	state.UpdatedAt = s.now().UTC()
383: 	if err := store.Publish(QAPublication{State: state, Flow: flow}, req.WriterToken); err != nil {
384: 		return s.publishTerminalQAFailure(store, flow, mapResult.Map, shards, state, req.WriterToken, err)
385: 	}
386: 	emitQA(req.Progress, QAProgress{Phase: QAPhaseSynthesizing, Event: "synthesis_started", Completed: state.CompletedShards, Total: state.TotalShards, Message: "QA synthesis started"})
387: 	var synthesis QASynthesis
388: 	for {
389: 		synthesis, err = SynthesizeQA(mapResult.Map, shards)
390: 		if err != nil {
391: 			return s.publishTerminalQAFailure(store, flow, mapResult.Map, shards, state, req.WriterToken, err)
392: 		}
393: 		follow := pendingQASynthesisFollowUps(synthesis, shards, mapResult.Map.Budgets.FollowUpShards)
394: 		if len(follow) == 0 {
395: 			break
396: 		}
397: 		state.TotalShards += len(follow)
398: 		shards = append(shards, follow...)
399: 		shards, state, runErr = s.runQAShardBatch(runCtx, store, flow, mapResult.Map, manifest.Target, shards, state, req)
400: 		if runErr != nil {
401: 			state = terminalQAState(state, runErr, s.now().UTC())
402: 			if publishErr := store.Publish(QAPublication{State: state, Flow: flow}, req.WriterToken); publishErr != nil {
403: 				return QARunResult{}, errors.Join(runErr, publishErr)
404: 			}
405: 			return QARunResult{Project: sp.Project, Sprint: sp.Slug, State: state, Map: mapResult.Map, Shards: shards}, runErr
406: 		}
407: 	}
408: 	if err := finalizeQASynthesisFollowUps(&synthesis, mapResult.Map, shards); err != nil {
409: 		return s.publishTerminalQAFailureWithSynthesis(store, flow, mapResult.Map, shards, synthesis, state, req.WriterToken, err)
410: 	}
411: 	state.OutcomeCounts = cloneQAOutcomeCounts(synthesis.OutcomeCounts)
412: 	state.Phase = QAPhaseCompleted
413: 	state.Run.Lifecycle = QARunTerminal
414: 	state.Run.TerminalResult = QATerminalCompleted
415: 	state.NextAction = synthesis.NextAction
416: 	state.UpdatedAt = s.now().UTC()
417: 	var evidencePublication *QAEvidencePublication
418: 	if req.EvidenceProducing {
419: 		bundle, assessment, evidenceErr := s.buildQAEvidencePublication(runCtx, sp, mapResult.Map, manifest.Target, shards, req.Progress)
420: 		if evidenceErr != nil {
421: 			return s.publishTerminalQAFailureWithSynthesis(store, flow, mapResult.Map, shards, synthesis, state, req.WriterToken, evidenceErr)
422: 		}
423: 		evidencePublication = &bundle
424: 		state.NextAction = assessment.NextAction
425: 		state.CanonicalAssessment = assessment.Assessment
426: 		if assessment.Assessment == AssessmentFail || assessment.Assessment == AssessmentBlocked || assessment.Assessment == AssessmentIncomplete {
427: 			state.Phase = QAPhaseBlocked
428: 			state.Run.TerminalResult = QATerminalBlocked
429: 		}
430: 	}
431: 	if err := store.Publish(QAPublication{Shards: shards, Synthesis: &synthesis, State: state, Flow: flow, Evidence: evidencePublication}, req.WriterToken); err != nil {
432: 		return QARunResult{}, err
433: 	}
434: 	loaded, err := store.LoadState()
435: 	if err != nil {
436: 		return QARunResult{}, err
437: 	}
438: 	emitQA(req.Progress, QAProgress{Phase: loaded.Phase, Event: "investigation_complete", Completed: loaded.CompletedShards, Total: loaded.TotalShards, Message: "QA investigation complete"})
439: 	return QARunResult{Project: sp.Project, Sprint: sp.Slug, State: loaded, Map: mapResult.Map, Shards: shards, Synthesis: synthesis}, nil
440: }

442: func (s Service) buildQAEvidencePublication(ctx context.Context, sp Sprint, qaMap QAMap, target string, shards []QAShard, progress func(QAProgress)) (QAEvidencePublication, QAAssessmentRecord, error) {
443: 	implementationBefore, err := targetIdentity(target)
444: 	if err != nil || implementationBefore != qaMap.ImplementationFingerprint {
445: 		return QAEvidencePublication{}, QAAssessmentRecord{}, NewQAError(QAErrorStaleInput, "admission", "implementation no longer matches the frozen QA map", err)
446: 	}
447: 	status, err := s.VerificationStatus(sp.Project, sp.Slug)
448: 	if err != nil {
449: 		return QAEvidencePublication{}, QAAssessmentRecord{}, NewQAError(QAErrorAdmissionBlocked, "admission", "verification prerequisites are unavailable", err)
450: 	}
451: 	capabilities := pprocess.IsolationCapabilityFacts()
452: 	admission := QAAdmission{
453: 		ReviewCurrent: status.Review.Fresh, ReviewVerdict: status.Review.Verdict,
454: 		SmokeCurrent: status.Smoke.Fresh, SmokeVerdict: status.Smoke.Verdict, ContainingSmoke: status.Smoke.Fresh,
455: 		ReadOnlyProofs: []string{"deterministic_map", "bounded_investigation", "synthesis"}, MapComplete: len(qaMap.Coverage.BlockedPaths) == 0 && len(qaMap.Coverage.PrimaryOwners) == len(qaMap.Coverage.ChangedPaths),
456: 		IsolationProven:     capabilities.NativeProtectedRootDeny && capabilities.DescendantCleanup && capabilities.WorkspaceRemoval,
457: 		WritableConcurrency: 1,
458: 	}
459: 	if err := ValidateQAAdmission(admission); err != nil {
460: 		return QAEvidencePublication{}, QAAssessmentRecord{}, err
461: 	}
462: 	limits := pprocess.IsolationLimits{MaxFiles: qaMap.Budgets.TreeFiles, MaxBytes: qaMap.Budgets.TreeBytes, MaxFileSize: qaMap.Budgets.FileBytes, Timeout: qaMap.Budgets.ShardTimeout}
463: 	targetTreeIdentity, err := pprocess.IdentifyTree(ctx, target, limits)
464: 	if err != nil {
465: 		return QAEvidencePublication{}, QAAssessmentRecord{}, NewQAError(QAErrorPermissionDenied, "admission", "cannot freeze the protected target identity", err)
466: 	}
467: 	mapFingerprint, err := fingerprintQAValue(qaMap)
468: 	if err != nil {
469: 		return QAEvidencePublication{}, QAAssessmentRecord{}, err
470: 	}
471: 	workspaceParent, err := os.MkdirTemp("", "ultraplan-qa-evidence-")
472: 	if err != nil {
473: 		return QAEvidencePublication{}, QAAssessmentRecord{}, NewQAError(QAErrorPermissionDenied, "admission", "cannot create the private QA workspace parent", err)
474: 	}
475: 	defer os.RemoveAll(workspaceParent)
476: 	plans := make([]QAEvidencePlan, 0, len(shards))
477: 	records := make([]QAEvidenceRecord, 0, len(shards))
478: 	candidates := make([]QAIssueCandidate, 0)
479: 	evaluators := make([]QAModelObservation, 0)
480: 	completedEvidence := 0
481: 	for _, shard := range shards {
482: 		if shard.Phase != QAPhaseCompleted {
483: 			continue
484: 		}
485: 		approvedPaths := normalizeQAStrings(append(append([]string(nil), shard.ChangedPaths...), shard.ContextPaths...))
486: 		if len(approvedPaths) == 0 {
487: 			continue
488: 		}
489: 		emitQA(progress, QAProgress{Phase: QAPhaseRunning, Event: "evidence_started", ShardID: shard.ID, Completed: completedEvidence, Total: len(shards), Message: "Running isolated evidence check"})
490: 		descriptors, checkErr := ApprovedQAChecks(target, shard.ChangedPaths, qaMap.Budgets)
491: 		if checkErr != nil {
492: 			return QAEvidencePublication{}, QAAssessmentRecord{}, checkErr
493: 		}
494: 		descriptor := QACheckDescriptor{Executable: "true", Timeout: qaMap.Budgets.CommandTimeout, OutputLimit: qaMap.Budgets.CommandOutputBytes}
495: 		if len(descriptors) > 0 {
496: 			descriptor = descriptors[0]
497: 		}
498: 		executable, lookupErr := exec.LookPath(descriptor.Executable)
499: 		if lookupErr != nil {
500: 			return QAEvidencePublication{}, QAAssessmentRecord{}, NewQAError(QAErrorAdmissionBlocked, "plan evidence", "an approved check executable is unavailable", lookupErr)
501: 		}
502: 		plan, planErr := FreezeQAEvidencePlan(sp.Project, sp.Slug, QAEvidencePlan{
503: 			AttemptID: qaMap.SemanticAttemptID, ShardID: shard.ID, ExpectationRefs: shard.ExpectationRefs,
504: 			Kind: QACheckFact, ConfirmationCondition: "approved check exits successfully", RefutationCondition: "approved check exits unsuccessfully", InconclusiveCondition: "approved check is incomplete",
505: 			ApprovedPaths: approvedPaths, Executable: executable, Args: append([]string(nil), descriptor.Args...), Timeout: descriptor.Timeout, OutputLimit: descriptor.OutputLimit,
506: 			CleanupRequired: true, GovernedInputFingerprint: qaMap.GovernedInputFingerprint, ImplementationFingerprint: qaMap.ImplementationFingerprint, MapFingerprint: mapFingerprint,
507: 		}, qaMap.Budgets, s.now().UTC())
508: 		if planErr != nil {
509: 			return QAEvidencePublication{}, QAAssessmentRecord{}, planErr
510: 		}
511: 		record, runErr := RunQAInvestigation(ctx, QAInvestigationRequest{Project: sp.Project, Sprint: sp.Slug, TargetRoot: target, WorkspaceParent: workspaceParent, ProtectedRoots: []string{s.root, target}, Plan: plan, Budgets: qaMap.Budgets, ExpectedTargetID: targetTreeIdentity.Digest, Now: s.now})
512: 		if runErr != nil {
513: 			return QAEvidencePublication{}, QAAssessmentRecord{}, runErr
514: 		}
515: 		if record.Outcome == QAEvidenceFail {
516: 			observations, finalOutcome, evaluationErr := s.evaluateFailedEvidence(ctx, sp, record, plan)
517: 			evaluators = append(evaluators, observations...)
518: 			if evaluationErr != nil {
519: 				record.Outcome, record.ReasonCode = QAEvidenceBlocked, "evaluator_incomplete"
520: 			} else {
521: 				record.Outcome = finalOutcome
522: 				record.Repeatable = finalOutcome == QAEvidenceFail
523: 				record.ReasonCode = "failed_shard_evaluated"
524: 			}
525: 		}
526: 		plans, records = append(plans, plan), append(records, record)
527: 		completedEvidence++
528: 		emitQA(progress, QAProgress{Phase: QAPhaseRunning, Event: "evidence_completed", ShardID: shard.ID, Completed: completedEvidence, Total: len(shards), Message: "Isolated evidence check complete"})
529: 		if record.Outcome == QAEvidenceFail {
530: 			title, claim, location := "Approved QA check failed", "an approved check failed in the isolated copy", approvedPaths[0]
531: 			if len(shard.Theories) > 0 {
532: 				title, claim, location = shard.Theories[0].Claim, shard.Theories[0].Claim, shard.Theories[0].VerificationSurface
533: 			}
534: 			candidates = append(candidates, QAIssueCandidate{Title: title, Claim: claim, IssueClass: "behavior", Severity: "medium", Location: location, EvidenceIDs: []string{record.ID}, RepairEligible: true, RegressionCandidate: true})
535: 		}
536: 	}
537: 	adjudication, err := AdjudicateQA(QAAdjudicationRequest{Project: sp.Project, Sprint: sp.Slug, AttemptID: qaMap.SemanticAttemptID, MapFingerprint: mapFingerprint, Plans: plans, Evidence: records, Candidates: candidates, Evaluators: evaluators, Budgets: qaMap.Budgets, Now: s.now().UTC()})
538: 	if err != nil {
539: 		return QAEvidencePublication{}, QAAssessmentRecord{}, err
540: 	}
541: 	assessmentValue, nextAction := DeriveQAAssessment(status.Review, records, adjudication, &status.Smoke, nil)
542: 	assessmentID, err := NewQAV2ID("assessment", sp.Project, sp.Slug, qaMap.SemanticAttemptID, struct {
543: 		Assessment OverallAssessment
544: 		Evidence   []string
545: 		Issues     int
546: 	}{assessmentValue, adjudication.AcceptedIDs, len(adjudication.Issues)})
547: 	if err != nil {
548: 		return QAEvidencePublication{}, QAAssessmentRecord{}, err
549: 	}
550: 	assessment := QAAssessmentRecord{SchemaVersion: QAEvidenceSchemaVersion, ID: assessmentID, AttemptID: qaMap.SemanticAttemptID, ReviewVerdict: ReviewVerdict(status.Review.Verdict), ReviewFingerprint: status.Review.InputFingerprint, SmokeVerdict: SmokeVerdict(status.Smoke.Verdict), SmokeRunID: status.Smoke.RunID, Assessment: assessmentValue, EvidenceTotal: len(records), RejectedTotal: len(adjudication.Rejected), IssueTotal: len(adjudication.Issues), NextAction: nextAction, CompletedAt: s.now().UTC()}
551: 	report, err := RenderQAReport(sp.Project, sp.Slug, qaMap.GovernedInputFingerprint, records, adjudication, assessment)
552: 	if err != nil {
553: 		return QAEvidencePublication{}, QAAssessmentRecord{}, err
554: 	}
555: 	implementationAfter, err := targetIdentity(target)
556: 	if err != nil || implementationAfter != implementationBefore {
557: 		return QAEvidencePublication{}, QAAssessmentRecord{}, NewQAError(QAErrorStaleInput, "publish evidence", "implementation changed during evidence production", err)
558: 	}
559: 	return QAEvidencePublication{Plans: plans, Records: records, Adjudication: &adjudication, Assessment: &assessment, Report: []byte(report), Budgets: qaMap.Budgets}, assessment, nil
560: }

582: func hydrateQASynthesisFollowUps(synthesis *QASynthesis, shards []QAShard) error {
583: 	byID := make(map[string]QAShard, len(shards))
584: 	for _, shard := range shards {
585: 		byID[shard.ID] = shard
586: 	}
587: 	for i := range synthesis.FollowUpShards {
588: 		current, ok := byID[synthesis.FollowUpShards[i].ID]
589: 		if !ok || (current.Phase != QAPhaseCompleted && current.Phase != QAPhaseBlocked) {
590: 			return NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "synthesize", "a proposed follow-up shard did not reach a retained terminal state", nil)
591: 		}
592: 		synthesis.FollowUpShards[i] = current
593: 	}
594: 	return nil
595: }

597: func pendingQASynthesisFollowUps(synthesis QASynthesis, shards []QAShard, limit int) []QAShard {
598: 	retained := make(map[string]struct{}, len(shards))
599: 	followUpCount := 0
600: 	for _, shard := range shards {
601: 		retained[shard.ID] = struct{}{}
602: 		if shard.Kind == QAShardFollowUp {
603: 			followUpCount++
604: 		}
605: 	}
606: 	remaining := limit - followUpCount
607: 	if remaining <= 0 {
608: 		return nil
609: 	}
610: 	pending := make([]QAShard, 0, remaining)
611: 	for _, follow := range synthesis.FollowUpShards {
612: 		if _, ok := retained[follow.ID]; ok {
613: 			continue
614: 		}
615: 		pending = append(pending, follow)
616: 		if len(pending) == remaining {
617: 			break
618: 		}
619: 	}
620: 	return pending
621: }

623: func finalizeQASynthesisFollowUps(synthesis *QASynthesis, qaMap QAMap, shards []QAShard) error {
624: 	followUps := make([]QAShard, 0, qaMap.Budgets.FollowUpShards)
625: 	for _, shard := range shards {
626: 		if shard.Kind != QAShardFollowUp {
627: 			continue
628: 		}
629: 		if shard.Phase != QAPhaseCompleted && shard.Phase != QAPhaseBlocked {
630: 			return NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "synthesize", "a retained follow-up shard did not reach a terminal state", nil)
631: 		}
632: 		followUps = append(followUps, shard)
633: 	}
634: 	if len(followUps) > qaMap.Budgets.FollowUpShards {
635: 		return NewQAError(QAErrorBudgetExhausted, "synthesize", "retained follow-up shards exceed the configured budget", nil)
636: 	}
637: 	sort.Slice(followUps, func(i, j int) bool { return followUps[i].ID < followUps[j].ID })
638: 	synthesis.FollowUpShards = followUps
639: 	followIDs := make([]string, 0, len(followUps))
640: 	for _, follow := range followUps {
641: 		followIDs = append(followIDs, follow.ID)
642: 	}
643: 	challengeIDs := make([]string, 0, len(synthesis.Challenges))
644: 	for _, challenge := range synthesis.Challenges {
645: 		challengeIDs = append(challengeIDs, challenge.ID)
646: 	}
647: 	id, err := NewQASynthesisID(qaMap.Project, qaMap.Sprint, qaMap.SemanticAttemptID, QASynthesisIdentity{MapID: qaMap.ID, TheoryIDs: synthesis.TheoryIDs, ChallengeIDs: challengeIDs, FollowUpIDs: followIDs, PolicyFingerprint: qaMap.PolicyFingerprint})
648: 	if err != nil {
649: 		return err
650: 	}
651: 	synthesis.ID = id
652: 	synthesis.NextAction = "Inspect the retained theory outcomes."
653: 	if len(synthesis.Blockers) > 0 {
654: 		synthesis.NextAction = "Inspect the retained shard blockers and resume only after their stated prerequisites are restored."
655: 	}
656: 	if err := ValidateQASynthesis(*synthesis, qaMap.Budgets); err != nil {
657: 		return NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "synthesize", err.Error(), err)
658: 	}
659: 	return nil
660: }

662: func (s Service) prepareQAAttempt(store QAStore, flow FlowState, qaMap QAMap, req QARunRequest, settings QASettings) (QAState, []QAShard, error) {
663: 	now := s.now().UTC()
664: 	if req.Resume {
665: 		prior, err := store.LoadState()
666: 		if err == nil && prior.CurrentAttemptID == qaMap.SemanticAttemptID && prior.Map != nil {
667: 			shards := append([]QAShard(nil), qaMap.Shards...)
668: 			for i := range shards {
669: 				loaded, loadErr := store.LoadShard(qaMap.SemanticAttemptID, shards[i].ID)
670: 				if loadErr == nil && (loaded.Phase == QAPhaseCompleted || loaded.Phase == QAPhaseBlocked) {
671: 					shards[i] = loaded
672: 				}
673: 			}
674: 			prior.Run = qaRunCorrelation(req.WriterToken, QARunClaimed)
675: 			prior.Phase = QAPhaseQueued
676: 			prior.Blocker = nil
677: 			prior.Cancellation = QACancellation{}
678: 			prior.CompletedShards = countTerminalQAShards(shards)
679: 			prior.TotalShards = len(shards)
680: 			prior.NextAction = "Resume incomplete shards from the current semantic attempt."
681: 			prior.UpdatedAt = now
682: 			if err := store.Publish(QAPublication{State: prior, Flow: flow}, req.WriterToken); err != nil {
683: 				return QAState{}, nil, err
684: 			}
685: 			return prior, shards, nil
686: 		}
687: 	}
688: 	state := QAState{SchemaVersion: QASchemaVersion, Project: qaMap.Project, Sprint: qaMap.Sprint, Phase: QAPhaseMapped,
689: 		Freshness:        QAFreshness{Current: true, GovernedInputFingerprint: qaMap.GovernedInputFingerprint, ImplementationFingerprint: qaMap.ImplementationFingerprint, ReviewFingerprint: qaMap.ReviewFingerprint, PolicyFingerprint: qaMap.PolicyFingerprint},
690: 		CurrentAttemptID: qaMap.SemanticAttemptID, CompletedShards: countTerminalQAShards(qaMap.Shards), TotalShards: len(qaMap.Shards), Run: qaRunCorrelation(req.WriterToken, QARunClaimed), NextAction: "Run the mapped read-only QA shards.", UpdatedAt: now}
691: 	shards := append([]QAShard(nil), qaMap.Shards...)
692: 	if err := store.Publish(QAPublication{Map: &qaMap, Shards: shards, State: state, Flow: flow}, req.WriterToken); err != nil {
693: 		return QAState{}, nil, err
694: 	}
695: 	loaded, err := store.LoadState()
696: 	if err != nil {
697: 		return QAState{}, nil, err
698: 	}
699: 	if err := store.PruneAttempts(qaMap.SemanticAttemptID, settings.Budgets.RetainedAttempts); err != nil {
700: 		return QAState{}, nil, err
701: 	}
702: 	return loaded, shards, nil
703: }

705: func (s Service) runQAShardBatch(ctx context.Context, store QAStore, flow FlowState, qaMap QAMap, target string, shards []QAShard, state QAState, req QARunRequest) ([]QAShard, QAState, error) {
706: 	batchCtx, cancel := context.WithCancel(ctx)
707: 	defer cancel()
708: 	abortResults := make(chan struct{})
709: 	indices := make([]int, 0, len(shards))
710: 	for i := range shards {
711: 		if shards[i].Phase == QAPhaseCompleted || shards[i].Phase == QAPhaseBlocked {
712: 			continue
713: 		}
714: 		if req.FocusShard != "" && shards[i].ID != req.FocusShard {
715: 			continue
716: 		}
717: 		indices = append(indices, i)
718: 	}
719: 	if req.FocusShard != "" && len(indices) == 0 {
720: 		return shards, state, NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "run", "focused shard is absent or already terminal", nil)
721: 	}
722: 	workers := qaMap.Budgets.ConcurrentInvestigators
723: 	if workers > len(indices) {
724: 		workers = len(indices)
725: 	}
726: 	if workers == 0 {
727: 		return shards, state, nil
728: 	}
729: 	jobs := make(chan int, workers)
730: 	results := make(chan qaShardResult, workers)
731: 	var group sync.WaitGroup
732: 	for i := 0; i < workers; i++ {
733: 		group.Add(1)
734: 		go func() {
735: 			defer group.Done()
736: 			for index := range jobs {
737: 				shard, err := s.runOneQAShardSafely(batchCtx, qaMap, shards[index], target, req.WriterToken)
738: 				select {
739: 				case results <- qaShardResult{shard: shard, err: err}:
740: 				case <-abortResults:
741: 					return
742: 				}
743: 			}
744: 		}()
745: 	}
746: 	go func() {
747: 		defer close(jobs)
748: 		for _, index := range indices {
749: 			select {
750: 			case jobs <- index:
751: 			case <-batchCtx.Done():
752: 				return
753: 			}
754: 		}
755: 	}()
756: 	go func() {
757: 		group.Wait()
758: 		close(results)
759: 	}()
760: 	byID := make(map[string]int, len(shards))
761: 	for i := range shards {
762: 		byID[shards[i].ID] = i
763: 	}
764: 	var publishErr error
765: 	for result := range results {
766: 		if publishErr != nil {
767: 			continue
768: 		}
769: 		index := byID[result.shard.ID]
770: 		if result.err != nil {
771: 			switch {
772: 			case errors.Is(result.err, context.Canceled):
773: 				result.shard.Phase = QAPhaseCancelled
774: 			case errors.Is(result.err, context.DeadlineExceeded):
775: 				result.shard.Phase = QAPhaseInterrupted
776: 			default:
777: 				result.shard.Phase = QAPhaseBlocked
778: 			}
779: 			result.shard.Blocker = qaBlocker(result.err, result.shard.ID)
780: 		}
781: 		shards[index] = result.shard
782: 		state.CompletedShards = countTerminalQAShards(shards)
783: 		state.UpdatedAt = s.now().UTC()
784: 		if err := store.Publish(QAPublication{Shards: []QAShard{result.shard}, State: state, Flow: flow}, req.WriterToken); err != nil {
785: 			publishErr = err
786: 			close(abortResults)
787: 			cancel()
788: 			continue
789: 		}
790: 		emitQA(req.Progress, QAProgress{Phase: state.Phase, ShardID: result.shard.ID, ShardKind: result.shard.Kind, ShardPhase: result.shard.Phase, Event: "shard_terminal", Completed: state.CompletedShards, Total: state.TotalShards, Message: "QA shard reached a terminal state"})
791: 	}
792: 	if publishErr != nil {
793: 		return shards, state, publishErr
794: 	}
795: 	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
796: 		return shards, state, err
797: 	}
798: 	return shards, state, nil
799: }

801: func (s Service) runOneQAShardSafely(ctx context.Context, qaMap QAMap, shard QAShard, target string, token QAWriterToken) (result QAShard, err error) {
802: 	result = shard
803: 	defer func() {
804: 		if recovered := recover(); recovered != nil {
805: 			err = NewQAError(QAErrorRuntimeUnavailable, "investigate shard", "investigator runtime panicked", fmt.Errorf("panic: %v", recovered))
806: 		}
807: 	}()
808: 	return s.runOneQAShard(ctx, qaMap, shard, target, token)
809: }

811: func (s Service) runOneQAShard(ctx context.Context, qaMap QAMap, shard QAShard, target string, token QAWriterToken) (QAShard, error) {
812: 	if err := s.validateCurrentQAMap(qaMap); err != nil {
813: 		return shard, err
814: 	}
815: 	request, err := s.QAInvestigatorRequest(qaMap, shard, target)
816: 	if err != nil {
817: 		return shard, err
818: 	}
819: 	request.Metadata["operation"] = "qa-investigate"
820: 	request.Metadata["task"] = shard.ID
821: 	request.Metadata["operational_attempt"] = token.OperationalAttemptID
822: 	capture := &qaOutputCapture{}
823: 	request.Validation = qaInvestigatorValidationSpec(qaMap.Budgets, capture)
824: 	previousOnEvent := request.OnEvent
825: 	request.OnEvent = func(event pruntime.Event) {
826: 		capture.observe(event.Payload)
827: 		if previousOnEvent != nil {
828: 			previousOnEvent(event)
829: 		}
830: 	}
831: 	before, identityErr := targetIdentity(target)
832: 	if identityErr != nil || before != qaMap.ImplementationFingerprint {
833: 		return shard, NewQAError(QAErrorStaleInput, "investigate shard", "implementation identity no longer matches the QA map", identityErr)
834: 	}
835: 	started := s.now().UTC()
836: 	result, runErr := s.runtime.StartRun(ctx, request)
837: 	if result.TerminalOutput == "" {
838: 		result.TerminalOutput = capture.load()
839: 	}
840: 	completed := s.now().UTC()
841: 	after, afterErr := targetIdentity(target)
842: 	attempt := QAInvestigatorAttempt{ID: fmt.Sprintf("%s/%s/1", token.OperationalAttemptID, shard.ID), Number: 1, StartedAt: started, CompletedAt: &completed, ImplementationBefore: before, ImplementationAfter: after, Usage: qaUsageSummary(result.Usage)}
843: 	if result.Repair.Configured {
844: 		attempt.Repair = &QARepairDiagnostic{Attempted: result.Repair.Attempted, MaxAttempts: result.Repair.MaxAttempts, AttemptCount: result.Repair.AttemptCount, Exhausted: result.Repair.Exhausted, ExhaustedReason: result.Repair.ExhaustedReason, PermissionDenied: result.Repair.PermissionDenied, UnsupportedSameSession: result.Repair.UnsupportedSameSession}
845: 	}
846: 	if result.EstimatedCost != nil {
847: 		attempt.EstimatedCost = &QACostSummary{Amount: result.EstimatedCost.Amount, Currency: result.EstimatedCost.Currency, Estimate: result.EstimatedCost.Estimate}
848: 	}
849: 	if afterErr != nil || after != before {
850: 		attempt.StopReason = "implementation identity drift"
851: 		shard.Attempts = append(shard.Attempts, attempt)
852: 		return shard, NewQAError(QAErrorPermissionDenied, "investigate shard", "implementation identity changed during read-only investigation", afterErr)
853: 	}
854: 	if currentErr := s.validateCurrentQAMap(qaMap); currentErr != nil {
855: 		attempt.StopReason = "governed input drift"
856: 		shard.Attempts = append(shard.Attempts, attempt)
857: 		return shard, currentErr
858: 	}
859: 	if result.Permissions.Mode != "restricted" || result.Permissions.Default != "deny" || result.Permissions.UnsupportedCount != 0 {
860: 		attempt.StopReason = "permission enforcement unavailable"
861: 		shard.Attempts = append(shard.Attempts, attempt)
862: 		return shard, NewQAError(QAErrorPermissionDenied, "investigate shard", "runtime did not enforce restricted default-deny permissions", nil)
863: 	}
864: 	if result.Validation.Configured && !result.Validation.Passed {
865: 		_, diagnostic, decodeErr := decodeQAInvestigatorOutput(result, qaMap.Budgets.ShardOutputBytes)
866: 		attempt.FailureKind, attempt.StopReason, attempt.OutputDiagnostic = "invalid_output", "investigator output repair exhausted", &diagnostic
867: 		shard.Attempts = append(shard.Attempts, attempt)
868: 		detail := fmt.Sprintf("investigator output repair exhausted after %d repair attempts", result.Repair.AttemptCount)
869: 		return shard, NewQAError(QAErrorBudgetExhausted, "investigate shard", detail, decodeErr)
870: 	}
871: 	if runErr != nil {
872: 		attempt.FailureKind, attempt.Retryable = classifyQARuntimeFailure(result, runErr)
873: 		attempt.StopReason = "runtime policy exhausted"
874: 		shard.Attempts = append(shard.Attempts, attempt)
875: 		if errors.Is(runErr, context.Canceled) || errors.Is(runErr, context.DeadlineExceeded) {
876: 			return shard, runErr
877: 		}
878: 		return shard, NewQAError(QAErrorRuntimeUnavailable, "investigate shard", "runtime resilience policy exhausted", runErr)
879: 	}
880: 	if result.Usage.TurnsKnown && result.Usage.Turns > int64(qaMap.Budgets.IterationsPerAttempt) {
881: 		attempt.StopReason = "investigator iteration limit exceeded"
882: 		shard.Attempts = append(shard.Attempts, attempt)
883: 		return shard, NewQAError(QAErrorBudgetExhausted, "investigate shard", fmt.Sprintf("investigator used %d turns; limit is %d", result.Usage.Turns, qaMap.Budgets.IterationsPerAttempt), nil)
884: 	}
885: 	output, diagnostic, decodeErr := decodeQAInvestigatorOutput(result, qaMap.Budgets.ShardOutputBytes)
886: 	if decodeErr != nil {
887: 		// Alternate runtimes may ignore ValidationSpec. Fail closed without
888: 		// adding a second product-owned retry loop.
889: 		attempt.FailureKind, attempt.StopReason, attempt.OutputDiagnostic = "invalid_output", "investigator output rejected", &diagnostic
890: 		shard.Attempts = append(shard.Attempts, attempt)
891: 		return shard, NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "investigate shard", "runtime returned invalid investigator output without validation repair metadata", decodeErr)
892: 	}
893: 	attempt.StopReason = "terminal investigator output accepted"
894: 	if len(output.Theories) > qaMap.Budgets.TheoriesPerShard || len(output.Context) > qaMap.Budgets.ContextExpansions || len(output.Checks) > qaMap.Budgets.CommandsPerAttempt {
895: 		return shard, NewQAError(QAErrorBudgetExhausted, "investigate shard", "investigator output exceeds map-owned limits", nil)
896: 	}
897: 	attempt.ContextRequests = append([]QAContextRequest(nil), output.Context...)
898: 	attempt.Evidence = append([]QAEvidenceSummary(nil), output.Evidence...)
899: 	for _, contextRequest := range attempt.ContextRequests {
900: 		if contextRequest.Approved {
901: 			return shard, NewQAError(QAErrorPermissionDenied, "investigate shard", "runtime cannot self-approve context expansion", nil)
902: 		}
903: 		if len(contextRequest.Paths) > qaMap.Budgets.PathsPerExpansion {
904: 			return shard, NewQAError(QAErrorBudgetExhausted, "investigate shard", "context request exceeds path limit", nil)
905: 		}
906: 		for _, path := range contextRequest.Paths {
907: 			if err := validateQAPath(path); err != nil {
908: 				return shard, NewQAError(QAErrorPermissionDenied, "investigate shard", err.Error(), err)
909: 			}
910: 		}
911: 	}
912: 	checks, err := ApprovedQAChecks(target, qaMap.Coverage.ChangedPaths, qaMap.Budgets)
913: 	if err != nil {
914: 		return shard, err
915: 	}
916: 	checkByID := map[string]QACheckDescriptor{}
917: 	for _, descriptor := range checks {
918: 		checkByID[descriptor.ID] = descriptor
919: 	}
920: 	for _, requested := range output.Checks {
921: 		descriptor, ok := checkByID[requested.ID]
922: 		if !ok {
923: 			return shard, NewQAError(QAErrorPermissionDenied, "investigate shard", "runtime requested a check outside the map-owned catalog", nil)
924: 		}
925: 		summary, checkErr := s.RunApprovedQACheck(ctx, qaMap, descriptor, requested)
926: 		attempt.Commands = append(attempt.Commands, summary)
927: 		if checkErr != nil {
928: 			return shard, checkErr
929: 		}
930: 	}
931: 	theories := make([]QATheory, 0, len(output.Theories))
932: 	for _, draft := range output.Theories {
933: 		identity := QATheoryIdentity{Claim: draft.Claim, Basis: draft.Basis, VerificationSurface: draft.VerificationSurface, ExpectationRefs: normalizeQAStrings(draft.ExpectationRefs)}
934: 		id, idErr := NewQATheoryID(qaMap.Project, qaMap.Sprint, shard.ID, identity)
935: 		if idErr != nil {
936: 			return shard, idErr
937: 		}
938: 		theory := QATheory{SchemaVersion: QASchemaVersion, ID: id, ShardID: shard.ID, Claim: draft.Claim, Basis: draft.Basis, VerificationSurface: draft.VerificationSurface, ExpectationRefs: identity.ExpectationRefs, SeverityIfConfirmed: draft.SeverityIfConfirmed, ConfirmationCondition: draft.ConfirmationCondition, RefutationCondition: draft.RefutationCondition, InconclusiveCondition: draft.InconclusiveCondition, SafeEvidenceStrategy: draft.SafeEvidenceStrategy, ImplementationFingerprint: attempt.ImplementationBefore, AttemptHistory: append(append([]QAInvestigatorAttempt(nil), shard.Attempts...), attempt), Evidence: append([]QAEvidenceSummary(nil), output.Evidence...), Outcome: draft.Outcome, OutcomeReason: draft.OutcomeReason}
939: 		if err := ValidateQATheory(theory); err != nil {
940: 			return shard, NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "investigate shard", err.Error(), err)
941: 		}
942: 		theories = append(theories, theory)
943: 	}
944: 	if len(theories) == 0 {
945: 		return shard, NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "investigate shard", "investigator returned no falsifiable theories", nil)
946: 	}
947: 	if err := s.validateCurrentQAMap(qaMap); err != nil {
948: 		return shard, err
949: 	}
950: 	sort.Slice(theories, func(i, j int) bool { return theories[i].ID < theories[j].ID })
951: 	shard.Attempts = append(shard.Attempts, attempt)
952: 	shard.Theories = theories
953: 	shard.Phase = QAPhaseCompleted
954: 	shard.Blocker = nil
955: 	return shard, nil
956: }

958: func qaSafeDiagnostic(value string) string {

960: 		if r == '\n' || r == '\r' || r == '\x00' {
961: 			return ' '
962: 		}
963: 		return r
964: 	}, value)
965: 	if len(value) > 512 {
966: 		value = value[:512]
967: 	}
968: 	return value

988: func decodeQAInvestigatorOutput(result pruntime.Result, limit int) (qaInvestigatorOutput, QAOutputDiagnostic, error) {
989: 	content := result.TerminalOutput
990: 	source := "terminal_output"
991: 	if content == "" {
992: 		source = "event"
993: 		for i := len(result.Events) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
994: 			if value, ok := result.Events[i].Payload["content"].(string); ok && value != "" {
995: 				content = value
996: 				break
997: 			}
998: 		}
999: 	}
1000: 	diagnostic := QAOutputDiagnostic{Source: source, OutputBytes: len(content), EventCount: len(result.Events), Status: result.Status, Session: result.SessionID != "", UsageKnown: result.Usage.InputTokensKnown || result.Usage.OutputTokensKnown || result.Usage.TotalTokensKnown || result.Usage.TurnsKnown}
1001: 	if len(content) == 0 || len(content) > limit {
1002: 		diagnostic.Kind = "empty"
1003: 		detail := "terminal output is empty"
1004: 		if len(content) > limit {
1005: 			diagnostic.Kind, detail = "too_large", "terminal output exceeds the shard output limit"
1006: 		}
1007: 		diagnostic.Detail = detail
1008: 		return qaInvestigatorOutput{}, diagnostic, NewQAError(QAErrorBudgetExhausted, "decode investigator", detail, nil)
1009: 	}
1010: 	decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewBufferString(content))
1011: 	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
1012: 	var output qaInvestigatorOutput
1013: 	if err := decoder.Decode(&output); err != nil {
1014: 		diagnostic.Kind, diagnostic.Detail = qaJSONFailureKind(err), qaSafeDiagnostic(err.Error())
1015: 		return qaInvestigatorOutput{}, diagnostic, NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "decode investigator", "terminal output is not one strict QA JSON object", err)
1016: 	}
1017: 	var trailing any
1018: 	if err := decoder.Decode(&trailing); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
1019: 		diagnostic.Kind, diagnostic.Detail = "trailing_json", "terminal output has trailing JSON"
1020: 		return qaInvestigatorOutput{}, diagnostic, NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "decode investigator", "terminal output has trailing JSON", err)
1021: 	}
1022: 	if output.SchemaVersion != QASchemaVersion {
1023: 		diagnostic.Kind, diagnostic.Detail = "schema_version", fmt.Sprintf("unsupported investigator schema version %d", output.SchemaVersion)
1024: 		return qaInvestigatorOutput{}, diagnostic, NewQAError(QAErrorUnknownSchema, "decode investigator", diagnostic.Detail, nil)
1025: 	}
1026: 	if output.Theories == nil || output.Evidence == nil || output.Context == nil || output.Checks == nil {
1027: 		diagnostic.Kind, diagnostic.Detail = "missing_field", "all five top-level fields are required and array fields cannot be null"
1028: 		return qaInvestigatorOutput{}, diagnostic, NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "decode investigator", diagnostic.Detail, nil)
1029: 	}
1030: 	return output, QAOutputDiagnostic{}, nil
1031: }

1033: func qaJSONFailureKind(err error) string {
1034: 	message := err.Error()
1035: 	switch {
1036: 	case strings.Contains(message, "unknown field"):
1037: 		return "unknown_field"
1038: 	case strings.Contains(message, "cannot unmarshal"):
1039: 		return "type_mismatch"
1040: 	default:
1041: 		return "syntax"
1042: 	}
1043: }

1045: func terminalQAState(state QAState, err error, now time.Time) QAState {
1046: 	state.Run.Lifecycle = QARunTerminal
1047: 	state.UpdatedAt = now
1048: 	state.Blocker = qaBlocker(err, "attempt")

392: 		}
393: 		follow := pendingQASynthesisFollowUps(synthesis, shards, mapResult.Map.Budgets.FollowUpShards)
394: 		if len(follow) == 0 {
395: 			break
396: 		}
397: 		state.TotalShards += len(follow)
398: 		shards = append(shards, follow...)
399: 		shards, state, runErr = s.runQAShardBatch(runCtx, store, flow, mapResult.Map, manifest.Target, shards, state, req)
400: 		if runErr != nil {
401: 			state = terminalQAState(state, runErr, s.now().UTC())
402: 			if publishErr := store.Publish(QAPublication{State: state, Flow: flow}, req.WriterToken); publishErr != nil {
403: 				return QARunResult{}, errors.Join(runErr, publishErr)
404: 			}
405: 			return QARunResult{Project: sp.Project, Sprint: sp.Slug, State: state, Map: mapResult.Map, Shards: shards}, runErr
406: 		}
407: 	}
408: 	if err := finalizeQASynthesisFollowUps(&synthesis, mapResult.Map, shards); err != nil {
409: 		return s.publishTerminalQAFailureWithSynthesis(store, flow, mapResult.Map, shards, synthesis, state, req.WriterToken, err)
410: 	}
411: 	state.OutcomeCounts = cloneQAOutcomeCounts(synthesis.OutcomeCounts)
412: 	state.Phase = QAPhaseCompleted
413: 	state.Run.Lifecycle = QARunTerminal
414: 	state.Run.TerminalResult = QATerminalCompleted
415: 	state.NextAction = synthesis.NextAction
416: 	state.UpdatedAt = s.now().UTC()
417: 	var evidencePublication *QAEvidencePublication
418: 	if req.EvidenceProducing {
419: 		bundle, assessment, evidenceErr := s.buildQAEvidencePublication(runCtx, sp, mapResult.Map, manifest.Target, shards, req.Progress)
420: 		if evidenceErr != nil {
421: 			return s.publishTerminalQAFailureWithSynthesis(store, flow, mapResult.Map, shards, synthesis, state, req.WriterToken, evidenceErr)
422: 		}
423: 		evidencePublication = &bundle
424: 		state.NextAction = assessment.NextAction
425: 		state.CanonicalAssessment = assessment.Assessment
426: 		if assessment.Assessment == AssessmentFail || assessment.Assessment == AssessmentBlocked || assessment.Assessment == AssessmentIncomplete {
427: 			state.Phase = QAPhaseBlocked
428: 			state.Run.TerminalResult = QATerminalBlocked
429: 		}
430: 	}
431: 	if err := store.Publish(QAPublication{Shards: shards, Synthesis: &synthesis, State: state, Flow: flow, Evidence: evidencePublication}, req.WriterToken); err != nil {
432: 		return QARunResult{}, err
433: 	}
434: 	loaded, err := store.LoadState()
435: 	if err != nil {
436: 		return QARunResult{}, err
437: 	}
438: 	emitQA(req.Progress, QAProgress{Phase: loaded.Phase, Event: "investigation_complete", Completed: loaded.CompletedShards, Total: loaded.TotalShards, Message: "QA investigation complete"})
439: 	return QARunResult{Project: sp.Project, Sprint: sp.Slug, State: loaded, Map: mapResult.Map, Shards: shards, Synthesis: synthesis}, nil
440: }

442: func (s Service) buildQAEvidencePublication(ctx context.Context, sp Sprint, qaMap QAMap, target string, shards []QAShard, progress func(QAProgress)) (QAEvidencePublication, QAAssessmentRecord, error) {
443: 	implementationBefore, err := targetIdentity(target)
444: 	if err != nil || implementationBefore != qaMap.ImplementationFingerprint {
445: 		return QAEvidencePublication{}, QAAssessmentRecord{}, NewQAError(QAErrorStaleInput, "admission", "implementation no longer matches the frozen QA map", err)
446: 	}
447: 	status, err := s.VerificationStatus(sp.Project, sp.Slug)
448: 	if err != nil {
449: 		return QAEvidencePublication{}, QAAssessmentRecord{}, NewQAError(QAErrorAdmissionBlocked, "admission", "verification prerequisites are unavailable", err)
450: 	}
451: 	capabilities := pprocess.IsolationCapabilityFacts()
452: 	admission := QAAdmission{
453: 		ReviewCurrent: status.Review.Fresh, ReviewVerdict: status.Review.Verdict,
454: 		SmokeCurrent: status.Smoke.Fresh, SmokeVerdict: status.Smoke.Verdict, ContainingSmoke: status.Smoke.Fresh,
455: 		ReadOnlyProofs: []string{"deterministic_map", "bounded_investigation", "synthesis"}, MapComplete: len(qaMap.Coverage.BlockedPaths) == 0 && len(qaMap.Coverage.PrimaryOwners) == len(qaMap.Coverage.ChangedPaths),
456: 		IsolationProven:     capabilities.NativeProtectedRootDeny && capabilities.DescendantCleanup && capabilities.WorkspaceRemoval,
457: 		WritableConcurrency: 1,
458: 	}
459: 	if err := ValidateQAAdmission(admission); err != nil {
460: 		return QAEvidencePublication{}, QAAssessmentRecord{}, err
461: 	}
462: 	limits := pprocess.IsolationLimits{MaxFiles: qaMap.Budgets.TreeFiles, MaxBytes: qaMap.Budgets.TreeBytes, MaxFileSize: qaMap.Budgets.FileBytes, Timeout: qaMap.Budgets.ShardTimeout}
463: 	targetTreeIdentity, err := pprocess.IdentifyTree(ctx, target, limits)
464: 	if err != nil {
465: 		return QAEvidencePublication{}, QAAssessmentRecord{}, NewQAError(QAErrorPermissionDenied, "admission", "cannot freeze the protected target identity", err)
466: 	}
467: 	mapFingerprint, err := fingerprintQAValue(qaMap)
468: 	if err != nil {
469: 		return QAEvidencePublication{}, QAAssessmentRecord{}, err
470: 	}
471: 	workspaceParent, err := os.MkdirTemp("", "ultraplan-qa-evidence-")
472: 	if err != nil {
473: 		return QAEvidencePublication{}, QAAssessmentRecord{}, NewQAError(QAErrorPermissionDenied, "admission", "cannot create the private QA workspace parent", err)
474: 	}
475: 	defer os.RemoveAll(workspaceParent)
476: 	plans := make([]QAEvidencePlan, 0, len(shards))
477: 	records := make([]QAEvidenceRecord, 0, len(shards))
478: 	candidates := make([]QAIssueCandidate, 0)
479: 	evaluators := make([]QAModelObservation, 0)
480: 	completedEvidence := 0
481: 	for _, shard := range shards {
482: 		if shard.Phase != QAPhaseCompleted {
483: 			continue
484: 		}
485: 		approvedPaths := normalizeQAStrings(append(append([]string(nil), shard.ChangedPaths...), shard.ContextPaths...))
486: 		if len(approvedPaths) == 0 {
487: 			continue
488: 		}
489: 		emitQA(progress, QAProgress{Phase: QAPhaseRunning, Event: "evidence_started", ShardID: shard.ID, Completed: completedEvidence, Total: len(shards), Message: "Running isolated evidence check"})
490: 		descriptors, checkErr := ApprovedQAChecks(target, shard.ChangedPaths, qaMap.Budgets)
491: 		if checkErr != nil {
492: 			return QAEvidencePublication{}, QAAssessmentRecord{}, checkErr
493: 		}
494: 		descriptor := QACheckDescriptor{Executable: "true", Timeout: qaMap.Budgets.CommandTimeout, OutputLimit: qaMap.Budgets.CommandOutputBytes}
495: 		if len(descriptors) > 0 {
496: 			descriptor = descriptors[0]
497: 		}
498: 		executable, lookupErr := exec.LookPath(descriptor.Executable)
499: 		if lookupErr != nil {
500: 			return QAEvidencePublication{}, QAAssessmentRecord{}, NewQAError(QAErrorAdmissionBlocked, "plan evidence", "an approved check executable is unavailable", lookupErr)
501: 		}
502: 		plan, planErr := FreezeQAEvidencePlan(sp.Project, sp.Slug, QAEvidencePlan{
503: 			AttemptID: qaMap.SemanticAttemptID, ShardID: shard.ID, ExpectationRefs: shard.ExpectationRefs,
504: 			Kind: QACheckFact, ConfirmationCondition: "approved check exits successfully", RefutationCondition: "approved check exits unsuccessfully", InconclusiveCondition: "approved check is incomplete",
505: 			ApprovedPaths: approvedPaths, Executable: executable, Args: append([]string(nil), descriptor.Args...), Timeout: descriptor.Timeout, OutputLimit: descriptor.OutputLimit,
506: 			CleanupRequired: true, GovernedInputFingerprint: qaMap.GovernedInputFingerprint, ImplementationFingerprint: qaMap.ImplementationFingerprint, MapFingerprint: mapFingerprint,
507: 		}, qaMap.Budgets, s.now().UTC())
508: 		if planErr != nil {
509: 			return QAEvidencePublication{}, QAAssessmentRecord{}, planErr
510: 		}
511: 		record, runErr := RunQAInvestigation(ctx, QAInvestigationRequest{Project: sp.Project, Sprint: sp.Slug, TargetRoot: target, WorkspaceParent: workspaceParent, ProtectedRoots: []string{s.root, target}, Plan: plan, Budgets: qaMap.Budgets, ExpectedTargetID: targetTreeIdentity.Digest, Now: s.now})
512: 		if runErr != nil {
513: 			return QAEvidencePublication{}, QAAssessmentRecord{}, runErr
514: 		}
515: 		if record.Outcome == QAEvidenceFail {
516: 			observations, finalOutcome, evaluationErr := s.evaluateFailedEvidence(ctx, sp, record, plan)
517: 			evaluators = append(evaluators, observations...)
518: 			if evaluationErr != nil {
519: 				record.Outcome, record.ReasonCode = QAEvidenceBlocked, "evaluator_incomplete"
520: 			} else {
521: 				record.Outcome = finalOutcome
522: 				record.Repeatable = finalOutcome == QAEvidenceFail
523: 				record.ReasonCode = "failed_shard_evaluated"
524: 			}
525: 		}
526: 		plans, records = append(plans, plan), append(records, record)
527: 		completedEvidence++
528: 		emitQA(progress, QAProgress{Phase: QAPhaseRunning, Event: "evidence_completed", ShardID: shard.ID, Completed: completedEvidence, Total: len(shards), Message: "Isolated evidence check complete"})
529: 		if record.Outcome == QAEvidenceFail {
530: 			title, claim, location := "Approved QA check failed", "an approved check failed in the isolated copy", approvedPaths[0]
531: 			if len(shard.Theories) > 0 {
532: 				title, claim, location = shard.Theories[0].Claim, shard.Theories[0].Claim, shard.Theories[0].VerificationSurface
533: 			}
534: 			candidates = append(candidates, QAIssueCandidate{Title: title, Claim: claim, IssueClass: "behavior", Severity: "medium", Location: location, EvidenceIDs: []string{record.ID}, RepairEligible: true, RegressionCandidate: true})
535: 		}
536: 	}
537: 	adjudication, err := AdjudicateQA(QAAdjudicationRequest{Project: sp.Project, Sprint: sp.Slug, AttemptID: qaMap.SemanticAttemptID, MapFingerprint: mapFingerprint, Plans: plans, Evidence: records, Candidates: candidates, Evaluators: evaluators, Budgets: qaMap.Budgets, Now: s.now().UTC()})
538: 	if err != nil {
539: 		return QAEvidencePublication{}, QAAssessmentRecord{}, err
540: 	}
541: 	assessmentValue, nextAction := DeriveQAAssessment(status.Review, records, adjudication, &status.Smoke, nil)
542: 	assessmentID, err := NewQAV2ID("assessment", sp.Project, sp.Slug, qaMap.SemanticAttemptID, struct {
543: 		Assessment OverallAssessment
544: 		Evidence   []string
545: 		Issues     int
546: 	}{assessmentValue, adjudication.AcceptedIDs, len(adjudication.Issues)})
547: 	if err != nil {
548: 		return QAEvidencePublication{}, QAAssessmentRecord{}, err
549: 	}
550: 	assessment := QAAssessmentRecord{SchemaVersion: QAEvidenceSchemaVersion, ID: assessmentID, AttemptID: qaMap.SemanticAttemptID, ReviewVerdict: ReviewVerdict(status.Review.Verdict), ReviewFingerprint: status.Review.InputFingerprint, SmokeVerdict: SmokeVerdict(status.Smoke.Verdict), SmokeRunID: status.Smoke.RunID, Assessment: assessmentValue, EvidenceTotal: len(records), RejectedTotal: len(adjudication.Rejected), IssueTotal: len(adjudication.Issues), NextAction: nextAction, CompletedAt: s.now().UTC()}
551: 	report, err := RenderQAReport(sp.Project, sp.Slug, qaMap.GovernedInputFingerprint, records, adjudication, assessment)
552: 	if err != nil {
553: 		return QAEvidencePublication{}, QAAssessmentRecord{}, err
554: 	}
555: 	implementationAfter, err := targetIdentity(target)
556: 	if err != nil || implementationAfter != implementationBefore {
557: 		return QAEvidencePublication{}, QAAssessmentRecord{}, NewQAError(QAErrorStaleInput, "publish evidence", "implementation changed during evidence production", err)
558: 	}
559: 	return QAEvidencePublication{Plans: plans, Records: records, Adjudication: &adjudication, Assessment: &assessment, Report: []byte(report), Budgets: qaMap.Budgets}, assessment, nil
560: }

582: func hydrateQASynthesisFollowUps(synthesis *QASynthesis, shards []QAShard) error {
583: 	byID := make(map[string]QAShard, len(shards))
584: 	for _, shard := range shards {
585: 		byID[shard.ID] = shard
586: 	}
587: 	for i := range synthesis.FollowUpShards {
588: 		current, ok := byID[synthesis.FollowUpShards[i].ID]
589: 		if !ok || (current.Phase != QAPhaseCompleted && current.Phase != QAPhaseBlocked) {
590: 			return NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "synthesize", "a proposed follow-up shard did not reach a retained terminal state", nil)
591: 		}
592: 		synthesis.FollowUpShards[i] = current
593: 	}
594: 	return nil
595: }

597: func pendingQASynthesisFollowUps(synthesis QASynthesis, shards []QAShard, limit int) []QAShard {
598: 	retained := make(map[string]struct{}, len(shards))
599: 	followUpCount := 0
600: 	for _, shard := range shards {
601: 		retained[shard.ID] = struct{}{}
602: 		if shard.Kind == QAShardFollowUp {
603: 			followUpCount++
604: 		}
605: 	}
606: 	remaining := limit - followUpCount
607: 	if remaining <= 0 {
608: 		return nil
609: 	}
610: 	pending := make([]QAShard, 0, remaining)
611: 	for _, follow := range synthesis.FollowUpShards {
612: 		if _, ok := retained[follow.ID]; ok {
613: 			continue
614: 		}
615: 		pending = append(pending, follow)
616: 		if len(pending) == remaining {
617: 			break
618: 		}
619: 	}
620: 	return pending
621: }

623: func finalizeQASynthesisFollowUps(synthesis *QASynthesis, qaMap QAMap, shards []QAShard) error {
624: 	followUps := make([]QAShard, 0, qaMap.Budgets.FollowUpShards)
625: 	for _, shard := range shards {
626: 		if shard.Kind != QAShardFollowUp {
627: 			continue
628: 		}
629: 		if shard.Phase != QAPhaseCompleted && shard.Phase != QAPhaseBlocked {
630: 			return NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "synthesize", "a retained follow-up shard did not reach a terminal state", nil)
631: 		}
632: 		followUps = append(followUps, shard)
633: 	}
634: 	if len(followUps) > qaMap.Budgets.FollowUpShards {
635: 		return NewQAError(QAErrorBudgetExhausted, "synthesize", "retained follow-up shards exceed the configured budget", nil)
636: 	}
637: 	sort.Slice(followUps, func(i, j int) bool { return followUps[i].ID < followUps[j].ID })
638: 	synthesis.FollowUpShards = followUps
639: 	followIDs := make([]string, 0, len(followUps))
640: 	for _, follow := range followUps {
641: 		followIDs = append(followIDs, follow.ID)
642: 	}
643: 	challengeIDs := make([]string, 0, len(synthesis.Challenges))
644: 	for _, challenge := range synthesis.Challenges {
645: 		challengeIDs = append(challengeIDs, challenge.ID)
646: 	}
647: 	id, err := NewQASynthesisID(qaMap.Project, qaMap.Sprint, qaMap.SemanticAttemptID, QASynthesisIdentity{MapID: qaMap.ID, TheoryIDs: synthesis.TheoryIDs, ChallengeIDs: challengeIDs, FollowUpIDs: followIDs, PolicyFingerprint: qaMap.PolicyFingerprint})
648: 	if err != nil {
649: 		return err
650: 	}
651: 	synthesis.ID = id
652: 	synthesis.NextAction = "Inspect the retained theory outcomes."
653: 	if len(synthesis.Blockers) > 0 {
654: 		synthesis.NextAction = "Inspect the retained shard blockers and resume only after their stated prerequisites are restored."
655: 	}
656: 	if err := ValidateQASynthesis(*synthesis, qaMap.Budgets); err != nil {
657: 		return NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "synthesize", err.Error(), err)
658: 	}
659: 	return nil
660: }

662: func (s Service) prepareQAAttempt(store QAStore, flow FlowState, qaMap QAMap, req QARunRequest, settings QASettings) (QAState, []QAShard, error) {
663: 	now := s.now().UTC()
664: 	if req.Resume {
665: 		prior, err := store.LoadState()
666: 		if err == nil && prior.CurrentAttemptID == qaMap.SemanticAttemptID && prior.Map != nil {
667: 			shards := append([]QAShard(nil), qaMap.Shards...)
668: 			for i := range shards {
669: 				loaded, loadErr := store.LoadShard(qaMap.SemanticAttemptID, shards[i].ID)
670: 				if loadErr == nil && (loaded.Phase == QAPhaseCompleted || loaded.Phase == QAPhaseBlocked) {
671: 					shards[i] = loaded
672: 				}
673: 			}
674: 			prior.Run = qaRunCorrelation(req.WriterToken, QARunClaimed)
675: 			prior.Phase = QAPhaseQueued
676: 			prior.Blocker = nil
677: 			prior.Cancellation = QACancellation{}
678: 			prior.CompletedShards = countTerminalQAShards(shards)
679: 			prior.TotalShards = len(shards)
680: 			prior.NextAction = "Resume incomplete shards from the current semantic attempt."
681: 			prior.UpdatedAt = now
682: 			if err := store.Publish(QAPublication{State: prior, Flow: flow}, req.WriterToken); err != nil {
683: 				return QAState{}, nil, err
684: 			}
685: 			return prior, shards, nil
686: 		}
687: 	}
688: 	state := QAState{SchemaVersion: QASchemaVersion, Project: qaMap.Project, Sprint: qaMap.Sprint, Phase: QAPhaseMapped,
689: 		Freshness:        QAFreshness{Current: true, GovernedInputFingerprint: qaMap.GovernedInputFingerprint, ImplementationFingerprint: qaMap.ImplementationFingerprint, ReviewFingerprint: qaMap.ReviewFingerprint, PolicyFingerprint: qaMap.PolicyFingerprint},
690: 		CurrentAttemptID: qaMap.SemanticAttemptID, CompletedShards: countTerminalQAShards(qaMap.Shards), TotalShards: len(qaMap.Shards), Run: qaRunCorrelation(req.WriterToken, QARunClaimed), NextAction: "Run the mapped read-only QA shards.", UpdatedAt: now}
691: 	shards := append([]QAShard(nil), qaMap.Shards...)
692: 	if err := store.Publish(QAPublication{Map: &qaMap, Shards: shards, State: state, Flow: flow}, req.WriterToken); err != nil {
693: 		return QAState{}, nil, err
694: 	}
695: 	loaded, err := store.LoadState()
696: 	if err != nil {
697: 		return QAState{}, nil, err
698: 	}
699: 	if err := store.PruneAttempts(qaMap.SemanticAttemptID, settings.Budgets.RetainedAttempts); err != nil {
700: 		return QAState{}, nil, err
701: 	}
702: 	return loaded, shards, nil
703: }

705: func (s Service) runQAShardBatch(ctx context.Context, store QAStore, flow FlowState, qaMap QAMap, target string, shards []QAShard, state QAState, req QARunRequest) ([]QAShard, QAState, error) {
706: 	batchCtx, cancel := context.WithCancel(ctx)
707: 	defer cancel()
708: 	abortResults := make(chan struct{})
709: 	indices := make([]int, 0, len(shards))
710: 	for i := range shards {
711: 		if shards[i].Phase == QAPhaseCompleted || shards[i].Phase == QAPhaseBlocked {
712: 			continue
713: 		}
714: 		if req.FocusShard != "" && shards[i].ID != req.FocusShard {
715: 			continue
716: 		}
717: 		indices = append(indices, i)
718: 	}
719: 	if req.FocusShard != "" && len(indices) == 0 {
720: 		return shards, state, NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "run", "focused shard is absent or already terminal", nil)
721: 	}
722: 	workers := qaMap.Budgets.ConcurrentInvestigators
723: 	if workers > len(indices) {
724: 		workers = len(indices)
725: 	}
726: 	if workers == 0 {
727: 		return shards, state, nil
728: 	}
729: 	jobs := make(chan int, workers)
730: 	results := make(chan qaShardResult, workers)
731: 	var group sync.WaitGroup
732: 	for i := 0; i < workers; i++ {
733: 		group.Add(1)
734: 		go func() {
735: 			defer group.Done()
736: 			for index := range jobs {
737: 				shard, err := s.runOneQAShardSafely(batchCtx, qaMap, shards[index], target, req.WriterToken)
738: 				select {
739: 				case results <- qaShardResult{shard: shard, err: err}:
740: 				case <-abortResults:
741: 					return
742: 				}
743: 			}
744: 		}()
745: 	}
746: 	go func() {
747: 		defer close(jobs)
748: 		for _, index := range indices {
749: 			select {
750: 			case jobs <- index:
751: 			case <-batchCtx.Done():
752: 				return
753: 			}
754: 		}
755: 	}()
756: 	go func() {
757: 		group.Wait()
758: 		close(results)
759: 	}()
760: 	byID := make(map[string]int, len(shards))
761: 	for i := range shards {
762: 		byID[shards[i].ID] = i
763: 	}
764: 	var publishErr error
765: 	for result := range results {
766: 		if publishErr != nil {
767: 			continue
768: 		}
769: 		index := byID[result.shard.ID]
770: 		if result.err != nil {
771: 			switch {
772: 			case errors.Is(result.err, context.Canceled):
773: 				result.shard.Phase = QAPhaseCancelled
774: 			case errors.Is(result.err, context.DeadlineExceeded):
775: 				result.shard.Phase = QAPhaseInterrupted
776: 			default:
777: 				result.shard.Phase = QAPhaseBlocked
778: 			}
779: 			result.shard.Blocker = qaBlocker(result.err, result.shard.ID)
780: 		}
781: 		shards[index] = result.shard
782: 		state.CompletedShards = countTerminalQAShards(shards)
783: 		state.UpdatedAt = s.now().UTC()
784: 		if err := store.Publish(QAPublication{Shards: []QAShard{result.shard}, State: state, Flow: flow}, req.WriterToken); err != nil {
785: 			publishErr = err
786: 			close(abortResults)
787: 			cancel()
788: 			continue
789: 		}
790: 		emitQA(req.Progress, QAProgress{Phase: state.Phase, ShardID: result.shard.ID, ShardKind: result.shard.Kind, ShardPhase: result.shard.Phase, Event: "shard_terminal", Completed: state.CompletedShards, Total: state.TotalShards, Message: "QA shard reached a terminal state"})
791: 	}
792: 	if publishErr != nil {
793: 		return shards, state, publishErr
794: 	}

176: // RecoverQA reconciles an abandoned or stale QA pointer without creating a
177: // runtime or adopting any prior worker or session.
178: func (s Service) RecoverQA(ctx context.Context, projectRef, sprintRef string) (QASnapshot, error) {
179: 	lockedCtx, release, err := s.acquireMutationContext(ctx, projectRef, sprintRef)
180: 	if err != nil {
181: 		return QASnapshot{}, err
182: 	}
183: 	defer release()
184: 	_ = lockedCtx
185: 	sp, err := s.resolveMutationSprint(projectRef, sprintRef)
186: 	if err != nil {
187: 		return QASnapshot{}, err
188: 	}
189: 	store := NewQAStore(s.root, sp)
190: 	state, err := store.LoadState()
191: 	if err != nil {
192: 		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
193: 			return s.QAStatus(projectRef, sprintRef)
194: 		}
195: 		return QASnapshot{}, err
196: 	}
197: 	flow, err := LoadFlowState(s.root, sp)
198: 	if err != nil {
199: 		return QASnapshot{}, err
200: 	}
201: 	now := s.now().UTC()
202: 	changed := false
203: 	statePath, pathErr := store.StatePath()
204: 	if pathErr != nil {
205: 		return QASnapshot{}, pathErr
206: 	}
207: 	stateDigest, digestErr := hashFile(statePath)
208: 	if digestErr != nil {
209: 		return QASnapshot{}, NewQAError(QAErrorPersistenceFailure, "recover", "cannot fingerprint QA state", digestErr)
210: 	}
211: 	expectedSummary := qaFlowSummary(state, stateDigest, sp)
212: 	if flow.QA == nil || *flow.QA != *expectedSummary {
213: 		changed = true
214: 	}
215: 	switch state.Phase {
216: 	case QAPhaseQueued, QAPhaseRunning, QAPhaseSynthesizing:
217: 		changed = true
218: 		state.Phase = QAPhaseInterrupted
219: 		state.Run.Lifecycle = QARunTerminal
220: 		state.Run.TerminalResult = QATerminalInterrupted
221: 		state.Blocker = &QABlocker{Category: QAErrorConflict, Scope: "attempt", Summary: "the prior process stopped while QA work was active", NextAction: "Run qa resume to continue current valid shards with a new owner."}
222: 		state.NextAction = state.Blocker.NextAction
223: 	case QAPhaseMapped:
224: 		changed = true
225: 		state.Phase = QAPhaseInterrupted
226: 		state.NextAction = "Run qa resume to claim and execute the mapped shards."
227: 	}
228: 	if current, mapErr := s.QAMap(projectRef, sprintRef); mapErr != nil || current.Map.SemanticAttemptID != state.CurrentAttemptID {
229: 		changed = true
230: 		state.Phase = QAPhaseStale
231: 		state.Freshness.Current = false
232: 		state.Freshness.Reasons = []string{"governed QA inputs no longer match the retained semantic attempt"}
233: 		state.NextAction = "Run qa --dry-run, then start a new QA attempt from the current map."
234: 	}
235: 	if !changed {
236: 		return s.QAStatus(projectRef, sprintRef)
237: 	}
238: 	state.UpdatedAt = now
239: 	if err := store.SaveRecoveredState(state, flow); err != nil {
240: 		return QASnapshot{}, err
241: 	}
242: 	settings, settingsErr := s.effectiveQASettings()
243: 	if settingsErr == nil {
244: 		if err := store.PruneAttempts(state.CurrentAttemptID, settings.Budgets.RetainedAttempts); err != nil {
245: 			return QASnapshot{}, err
246: 		}
247: 	}
248: 	return s.QAStatus(projectRef, sprintRef)
249: }
