278: // RunQA owns one bounded read-only investigation attempt. Mapping stays pure;
279: // this method starts persistence and runtimes only after a valid writer token
280: // and the sprint mutation lease have both been acquired.
281: func (s Service) RunQA(ctx context.Context, projectRef, sprintRef string, req QARunRequest) (QARunResult, error) {
282: 	if req.Suite != "" {
283: 		if req.Suite != "smoke" {
284: 			return QARunResult{}, NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "run", "unsupported QA suite", nil)
285: 		}
286: 		if req.Resume || req.FocusShard != "" {
287: 			return QARunResult{}, NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "run", "the smoke QA suite cannot resume or focus a shard", nil)
288: 		}
289: 		if err := req.WriterToken.Validate(); err != nil {
290: 			return QARunResult{}, NewQAError(QAErrorConflict, "run", err.Error(), err)
291: 		}
292: 		smoke, smokeErr := s.RunSmoke(ctx, projectRef, sprintRef, SmokeRequest{Progress: func(progress SmokeProgress) {
293: 			emitQA(req.Progress, QAProgress{Phase: QAPhaseRunning, Event: "smoke_" + string(progress.Phase), Message: progress.Message})
294: 		}})
295: 		phase, terminal := QAPhaseCompleted, QATerminalCompleted
296: 		next := smoke.NextAction
297: 		if smokeErr != nil || smoke.Status != SmokeCompleted || smoke.Verdict == SmokeFailVerdict || smoke.Verdict == SmokeBlockedVerdict {
298: 			phase, terminal = QAPhaseBlocked, QATerminalBlocked
299: 		}
300: 		state := QAState{SchemaVersion: QASchemaVersion, Project: projectRef, Sprint: sprintRef, Phase: phase, Freshness: QAFreshness{Current: smokeErr == nil && !smoke.Stale}, Run: qaRunCorrelation(req.WriterToken, QARunTerminal), NextAction: next, UpdatedAt: s.now().UTC()}
301: 		state.Run.TerminalResult = terminal
302: 		return QARunResult{Project: projectRef, Sprint: sprintRef, State: state, Smoke: &smoke}, smokeErr
303: 	}
304: 	if s.runtime == nil {
305: 		return QARunResult{}, NewQAError(QAErrorRuntimeUnavailable, "run", "a QA runtime is required", nil)
306: 	}
307: 	if err := req.WriterToken.Validate(); err != nil {
308: 		return QARunResult{}, NewQAError(QAErrorConflict, "run", err.Error(), err)
309: 	}
310: 	settings, err := s.effectiveQASettings()
311: 	if err != nil {
312: 		return QARunResult{}, NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "run", "effective QA settings are invalid", err)
313: 	}
314: 	req.Progress = boundedQAProgress(req.Progress, settings.Budgets.RecentProgress)
315: 	lockedCtx, release, err := s.acquireMutationContext(ctx, projectRef, sprintRef)
316: 	if err != nil {
317: 		return QARunResult{}, err
318: 	}
319: 	defer release()
320: 	sp, err := s.resolveMutationSprint(projectRef, sprintRef)
321: 	if err != nil {
322: 		return QARunResult{}, err
323: 	}
324: 	fence := s.qaWriterFence
325: 	if fence == nil {
326: 		expected := req.WriterToken
327: 		fence = func(got QAWriterToken) error {
328: 			if got != expected {
329: 				return errors.New("writer token does not own this QA invocation")
330: 			}
331: 			return nil
332: 		}
333: 	}
334: 	store := NewQAStore(s.root, sp).WithWriterFence(fence)
335: 	if err := store.PruneAttempts("", settings.Budgets.RetainedAttempts); err != nil {
336: 		return QARunResult{}, err
337: 	}
338: 	if used, sizeErr := store.VerificationBytes(); sizeErr != nil {
339: 		return QARunResult{}, sizeErr
340: 	} else if used > int64(settings.Budgets.StateBytes) {
341: 		return QARunResult{}, NewQAError(QAErrorBudgetExhausted, "run", "retained QA state exceeds the configured state budget", nil)
342: 	}
343: 	mapResult, err := s.QAMap(projectRef, sprintRef)
344: 	if err != nil {
345: 		return QARunResult{}, err
346: 	}
347: 	manifest, findings, err := s.PrepareReview(projectRef, sprintRef, ReviewRequest{})
348: 	if err != nil || len(findings) > 0 {
349: 		return QARunResult{}, NewQAError(QAErrorStaleInput, "run", "cannot resolve the current governed target", err)
350: 	}
351: 	flow, err := LoadFlowState(s.root, sp)
352: 	if err != nil {
353: 		return QARunResult{}, NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "run", "flow state is unavailable", err)
354: 	}
355: 	state, shards, err := s.prepareQAAttempt(store, flow, mapResult.Map, req, settings)
356: 	if err != nil {
357: 		return QARunResult{}, err
358: 	}
359: 	emitQA(req.Progress, QAProgress{Phase: QAPhaseQueued, Event: "shards_queued", Completed: state.CompletedShards, Total: state.TotalShards, Message: "QA shards queued"})
360: 
361: 	runCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(lockedCtx, settings.Budgets.RunTimeout)
362: 	defer cancel()
363: 	state.Phase = QAPhaseRunning
364: 	state.Run.Lifecycle = QARunActive
365: 	state.NextAction = "Wait for the bounded read-only investigators."
366: 	state.UpdatedAt = s.now().UTC()
367: 	if err := store.Publish(QAPublication{State: state, Flow: flow}, req.WriterToken); err != nil {
368: 		return QARunResult{}, err
369: 	}
370: 	emitQA(req.Progress, QAProgress{Phase: QAPhaseRunning, Event: "investigation_started", Completed: state.CompletedShards, Total: state.TotalShards, Message: "QA investigation started"})
371: 	shards, state, runErr := s.runQAShardBatch(runCtx, store, flow, mapResult.Map, manifest.Target, shards, state, req)
372: 	if runErr != nil {
373: 		state = terminalQAState(state, runErr, s.now().UTC())
374: 		if publishErr := store.Publish(QAPublication{State: state, Flow: flow}, req.WriterToken); publishErr != nil {
375: 			return QARunResult{}, errors.Join(runErr, publishErr)
376: 		}
377: 		return QARunResult{Project: sp.Project, Sprint: sp.Slug, State: state, Map: mapResult.Map, Shards: shards}, runErr
378: 	}
379: 
380: 	state.Phase = QAPhaseSynthesizing
381: 	state.NextAction = "Synthesize the retained shard outcomes."
382: 	state.UpdatedAt = s.now().UTC()
383: 	if err := store.Publish(QAPublication{State: state, Flow: flow}, req.WriterToken); err != nil {
384: 		return s.publishTerminalQAFailure(store, flow, mapResult.Map, shards, state, req.WriterToken, err)
385: 	}
386: 	emitQA(req.Progress, QAProgress{Phase: QAPhaseSynthesizing, Event: "synthesis_started", Completed: state.CompletedShards, Total: state.TotalShards, Message: "QA synthesis started"})
387: 	synthesis, err := SynthesizeQA(mapResult.Map, shards)
388: 	if err != nil {
389: 		return s.publishTerminalQAFailure(store, flow, mapResult.Map, shards, state, req.WriterToken, err)
390: 	}
391: 	if len(synthesis.FollowUpShards) > 0 {
392: 		follow := append([]QAShard(nil), synthesis.FollowUpShards...)
393: 		state.TotalShards += len(follow)
394: 		shards = append(shards, follow...)
395: 		shards, state, runErr = s.runQAShardBatch(runCtx, store, flow, mapResult.Map, manifest.Target, shards, state, req)
396: 		if runErr != nil {
397: 			state = terminalQAState(state, runErr, s.now().UTC())
398: 			if publishErr := store.Publish(QAPublication{State: state, Flow: flow}, req.WriterToken); publishErr != nil {
399: 				return QARunResult{}, errors.Join(runErr, publishErr)
400: 			}
401: 			return QARunResult{Project: sp.Project, Sprint: sp.Slug, State: state, Map: mapResult.Map, Shards: shards}, runErr
402: 		}
403: 		synthesis, err = SynthesizeQA(mapResult.Map, shards)
404: 		if err != nil {
405: 			return s.publishTerminalQAFailure(store, flow, mapResult.Map, shards, state, req.WriterToken, err)
406: 		}
407: 	}
408: 	if err := hydrateQASynthesisFollowUps(&synthesis, shards); err != nil {
409: 		return s.publishTerminalQAFailure(store, flow, mapResult.Map, shards, state, req.WriterToken, err)
410: 	}
411: 	state.OutcomeCounts = cloneQAOutcomeCounts(synthesis.OutcomeCounts)
412: 	state.Phase = QAPhaseCompleted
413: 	state.Run.Lifecycle = QARunTerminal
414: 	state.Run.TerminalResult = QATerminalCompleted
415: 	state.NextAction = synthesis.NextAction
416: 	state.UpdatedAt = s.now().UTC()
417: 	var evidencePublication *QAEvidencePublication
418: 	if req.EvidenceProducing {
419: 		bundle, assessment, evidenceErr := s.buildQAEvidencePublication(runCtx, sp, mapResult.Map, manifest.Target, shards, req.Progress)
420: 		if evidenceErr != nil {
421: 			return s.publishTerminalQAFailure(store, flow, mapResult.Map, shards, state, req.WriterToken, evidenceErr)
422: 		}
423: 		evidencePublication = &bundle
424: 		state.NextAction = assessment.NextAction
425: 		state.CanonicalAssessment = assessment.Assessment
426: 		if assessment.Assessment == AssessmentFail || assessment.Assessment == AssessmentBlocked || assessment.Assessment == AssessmentIncomplete {
427: 			state.Phase = QAPhaseBlocked
428: 			state.Run.TerminalResult = QATerminalBlocked
429: 		}
430: 	}
431: 	if err := store.Publish(QAPublication{Shards: shards, Synthesis: &synthesis, State: state, Flow: flow, Evidence: evidencePublication}, req.WriterToken); err != nil {
432: 		return QARunResult{}, err
433: 	}
434: 	loaded, err := store.LoadState()
435: 	if err != nil {
436: 		return QARunResult{}, err
437: 	}
438: 	emitQA(req.Progress, QAProgress{Phase: loaded.Phase, Event: "investigation_complete", Completed: loaded.CompletedShards, Total: loaded.TotalShards, Message: "QA investigation complete"})
439: 	return QARunResult{Project: sp.Project, Sprint: sp.Slug, State: loaded, Map: mapResult.Map, Shards: shards, Synthesis: synthesis}, nil
440: }

442: func (s Service) buildQAEvidencePublication(ctx context.Context, sp Sprint, qaMap QAMap, target string, shards []QAShard, progress func(QAProgress)) (QAEvidencePublication, QAAssessmentRecord, error) {
443: 	status, err := s.VerificationStatus(sp.Project, sp.Slug)
444: 	if err != nil {
445: 		return QAEvidencePublication{}, QAAssessmentRecord{}, NewQAError(QAErrorAdmissionBlocked, "admission", "verification prerequisites are unavailable", err)
446: 	}
447: 	capabilities := pprocess.IsolationCapabilityFacts()
448: 	admission := QAAdmission{
449: 		ReviewCurrent: status.Review.Fresh, ReviewVerdict: status.Review.Verdict,
450: 		SmokeCurrent: status.Smoke.Fresh, SmokeVerdict: status.Smoke.Verdict, ContainingSmoke: status.Smoke.Fresh,
451: 		ReadOnlyProofs: []string{"deterministic_map", "bounded_investigation", "synthesis"}, MapComplete: len(qaMap.Coverage.BlockedPaths) == 0 && len(qaMap.Coverage.PrimaryOwners) == len(qaMap.Coverage.ChangedPaths),
452: 		IsolationProven:     capabilities.NativeProtectedRootDeny && capabilities.DescendantCleanup && capabilities.WorkspaceRemoval,
453: 		WritableConcurrency: 1,
454: 	}
455: 	if err := ValidateQAAdmission(admission); err != nil {
456: 		return QAEvidencePublication{}, QAAssessmentRecord{}, err
457: 	}
458: 	limits := pprocess.IsolationLimits{MaxFiles: qaMap.Budgets.TreeFiles, MaxBytes: qaMap.Budgets.TreeBytes, MaxFileSize: qaMap.Budgets.FileBytes, Timeout: qaMap.Budgets.ShardTimeout}
459: 	targetIdentity, err := pprocess.IdentifyTree(ctx, target, limits)
460: 	if err != nil {
461: 		return QAEvidencePublication{}, QAAssessmentRecord{}, NewQAError(QAErrorPermissionDenied, "admission", "cannot freeze the protected target identity", err)
462: 	}
463: 	mapFingerprint, err := fingerprintQAValue(qaMap)
464: 	if err != nil {
465: 		return QAEvidencePublication{}, QAAssessmentRecord{}, err
466: 	}
467: 	workspaceParent, err := os.MkdirTemp("", "ultraplan-qa-evidence-")
468: 	if err != nil {
469: 		return QAEvidencePublication{}, QAAssessmentRecord{}, NewQAError(QAErrorPermissionDenied, "admission", "cannot create the private QA workspace parent", err)
470: 	}
471: 	defer os.RemoveAll(workspaceParent)
472: 	plans := make([]QAEvidencePlan, 0, len(shards))
473: 	records := make([]QAEvidenceRecord, 0, len(shards))
474: 	candidates := make([]QAIssueCandidate, 0)
475: 	evaluators := make([]QAModelObservation, 0)
476: 	completedEvidence := 0
477: 	for _, shard := range shards {
478: 		if shard.Phase != QAPhaseCompleted {
479: 			continue
480: 		}
481: 		approvedPaths := normalizeQAStrings(append(append([]string(nil), shard.ChangedPaths...), shard.ContextPaths...))
482: 		if len(approvedPaths) == 0 {
483: 			continue
484: 		}
485: 		emitQA(progress, QAProgress{Phase: QAPhaseRunning, Event: "evidence_started", ShardID: shard.ID, Completed: completedEvidence, Total: len(shards), Message: "Running isolated evidence check"})
486: 		descriptors, checkErr := ApprovedQAChecks(target, shard.ChangedPaths, qaMap.Budgets)
487: 		if checkErr != nil {
488: 			return QAEvidencePublication{}, QAAssessmentRecord{}, checkErr
489: 		}
490: 		descriptor := QACheckDescriptor{Executable: "true", Timeout: qaMap.Budgets.CommandTimeout, OutputLimit: qaMap.Budgets.CommandOutputBytes}
491: 		if len(descriptors) > 0 {
492: 			descriptor = descriptors[0]
493: 		}
494: 		executable, lookupErr := exec.LookPath(descriptor.Executable)
495: 		if lookupErr != nil {
496: 			return QAEvidencePublication{}, QAAssessmentRecord{}, NewQAError(QAErrorAdmissionBlocked, "plan evidence", "an approved check executable is unavailable", lookupErr)
497: 		}
498: 		plan, planErr := FreezeQAEvidencePlan(sp.Project, sp.Slug, QAEvidencePlan{
499: 			AttemptID: qaMap.SemanticAttemptID, ShardID: shard.ID, ExpectationRefs: shard.ExpectationRefs,
500: 			Kind: QACheckFact, ConfirmationCondition: "approved check exits successfully", RefutationCondition: "approved check exits unsuccessfully", InconclusiveCondition: "approved check is incomplete",
501: 			ApprovedPaths: approvedPaths, Executable: executable, Args: append([]string(nil), descriptor.Args...), Timeout: descriptor.Timeout, OutputLimit: descriptor.OutputLimit,
502: 			CleanupRequired: true, GovernedInputFingerprint: qaMap.GovernedInputFingerprint, ImplementationFingerprint: qaMap.ImplementationFingerprint, MapFingerprint: mapFingerprint,
503: 		}, qaMap.Budgets, s.now().UTC())
504: 		if planErr != nil {
505: 			return QAEvidencePublication{}, QAAssessmentRecord{}, planErr
506: 		}
507: 		record, runErr := RunQAInvestigation(ctx, QAInvestigationRequest{Project: sp.Project, Sprint: sp.Slug, TargetRoot: target, WorkspaceParent: workspaceParent, ProtectedRoots: []string{s.root, target}, Plan: plan, Budgets: qaMap.Budgets, ExpectedTargetID: targetIdentity.Digest, Now: s.now})
508: 		if runErr != nil {
509: 			return QAEvidencePublication{}, QAAssessmentRecord{}, runErr
510: 		}
511: 		if record.Outcome == QAEvidenceFail {
512: 			observations, finalOutcome, evaluationErr := s.evaluateFailedEvidence(ctx, sp, record, plan)
513: 			evaluators = append(evaluators, observations...)
514: 			if evaluationErr != nil {
515: 				record.Outcome, record.ReasonCode = QAEvidenceBlocked, "evaluator_incomplete"
516: 			} else {
517: 				record.Outcome = finalOutcome
518: 				record.Repeatable = finalOutcome == QAEvidenceFail
519: 				record.ReasonCode = "failed_shard_evaluated"
520: 			}
521: 		}
522: 		plans, records = append(plans, plan), append(records, record)
523: 		completedEvidence++
524: 		emitQA(progress, QAProgress{Phase: QAPhaseRunning, Event: "evidence_completed", ShardID: shard.ID, Completed: completedEvidence, Total: len(shards), Message: "Isolated evidence check complete"})
525: 		if record.Outcome == QAEvidenceFail {
526: 			title, claim, location := "Approved QA check failed", "an approved check failed in the isolated copy", approvedPaths[0]
527: 			if len(shard.Theories) > 0 {
528: 				title, claim, location = shard.Theories[0].Claim, shard.Theories[0].Claim, shard.Theories[0].VerificationSurface
529: 			}
530: 			candidates = append(candidates, QAIssueCandidate{Title: title, Claim: claim, IssueClass: "behavior", Severity: "medium", Location: location, EvidenceIDs: []string{record.ID}, RepairEligible: true, RegressionCandidate: true})
531: 		}
532: 	}
533: 	adjudication, err := AdjudicateQA(QAAdjudicationRequest{Project: sp.Project, Sprint: sp.Slug, AttemptID: qaMap.SemanticAttemptID, MapFingerprint: mapFingerprint, Plans: plans, Evidence: records, Candidates: candidates, Evaluators: evaluators, Budgets: qaMap.Budgets, Now: s.now().UTC()})
534: 	if err != nil {
535: 		return QAEvidencePublication{}, QAAssessmentRecord{}, err
536: 	}
537: 	assessmentValue, nextAction := DeriveQAAssessment(status.Review, records, adjudication, &status.Smoke, nil)
538: 	assessmentID, err := NewQAV2ID("assessment", sp.Project, sp.Slug, qaMap.SemanticAttemptID, struct {
539: 		Assessment OverallAssessment
540: 		Evidence   []string
541: 		Issues     int
542: 	}{assessmentValue, adjudication.AcceptedIDs, len(adjudication.Issues)})
543: 	if err != nil {
544: 		return QAEvidencePublication{}, QAAssessmentRecord{}, err
545: 	}
546: 	assessment := QAAssessmentRecord{SchemaVersion: QAEvidenceSchemaVersion, ID: assessmentID, AttemptID: qaMap.SemanticAttemptID, ReviewVerdict: ReviewVerdict(status.Review.Verdict), ReviewFingerprint: status.Review.InputFingerprint, SmokeVerdict: SmokeVerdict(status.Smoke.Verdict), SmokeRunID: status.Smoke.RunID, Assessment: assessmentValue, EvidenceTotal: len(records), RejectedTotal: len(adjudication.Rejected), IssueTotal: len(adjudication.Issues), NextAction: nextAction, CompletedAt: s.now().UTC()}
547: 	report, err := RenderQAReport(sp.Project, sp.Slug, qaMap.GovernedInputFingerprint, records, adjudication, assessment)

550: 	}

577: func (s Service) prepareQAAttempt(store QAStore, flow FlowState, qaMap QAMap, req QARunRequest, settings QASettings) (QAState, []QAShard, error) {
578: 	now := s.now().UTC()
579: 	if req.Resume {
580: 		prior, err := store.LoadState()
581: 		if err == nil && prior.CurrentAttemptID == qaMap.SemanticAttemptID && prior.Map != nil {
582: 			shards := append([]QAShard(nil), qaMap.Shards...)
583: 			for i := range shards {
584: 				loaded, loadErr := store.LoadShard(qaMap.SemanticAttemptID, shards[i].ID)
585: 				if loadErr == nil && (loaded.Phase == QAPhaseCompleted || loaded.Phase == QAPhaseBlocked) {
586: 					shards[i] = loaded
587: 				}
588: 			}
589: 			prior.Run = qaRunCorrelation(req.WriterToken, QARunClaimed)
590: 			prior.Phase = QAPhaseQueued
591: 			prior.Blocker = nil
592: 			prior.Cancellation = QACancellation{}
593: 			prior.CompletedShards = countTerminalQAShards(shards)
594: 			prior.TotalShards = len(shards)
595: 			prior.NextAction = "Resume incomplete shards from the current semantic attempt."
596: 			prior.UpdatedAt = now
597: 			if err := store.Publish(QAPublication{State: prior, Flow: flow}, req.WriterToken); err != nil {
598: 				return QAState{}, nil, err
599: 			}
600: 			return prior, shards, nil
601: 		}
602: 	}
603: 	state := QAState{SchemaVersion: QASchemaVersion, Project: qaMap.Project, Sprint: qaMap.Sprint, Phase: QAPhaseMapped,
604: 		Freshness:        QAFreshness{Current: true, GovernedInputFingerprint: qaMap.GovernedInputFingerprint, ImplementationFingerprint: qaMap.ImplementationFingerprint, ReviewFingerprint: qaMap.ReviewFingerprint, PolicyFingerprint: qaMap.PolicyFingerprint},
605: 		CurrentAttemptID: qaMap.SemanticAttemptID, CompletedShards: countTerminalQAShards(qaMap.Shards), TotalShards: len(qaMap.Shards), Run: qaRunCorrelation(req.WriterToken, QARunClaimed), NextAction: "Run the mapped read-only QA shards.", UpdatedAt: now}
606: 	shards := append([]QAShard(nil), qaMap.Shards...)
607: 	if err := store.Publish(QAPublication{Map: &qaMap, Shards: shards, State: state, Flow: flow}, req.WriterToken); err != nil {
608: 		return QAState{}, nil, err
609: 	}
610: 	loaded, err := store.LoadState()
611: 	if err != nil {
612: 		return QAState{}, nil, err
613: 	}
614: 	if err := store.PruneAttempts(qaMap.SemanticAttemptID, settings.Budgets.RetainedAttempts); err != nil {
615: 		return QAState{}, nil, err
616: 	}
617: 	return loaded, shards, nil
618: }

620: func (s Service) runQAShardBatch(ctx context.Context, store QAStore, flow FlowState, qaMap QAMap, target string, shards []QAShard, state QAState, req QARunRequest) ([]QAShard, QAState, error) {
621: 	batchCtx, cancel := context.WithCancel(ctx)
622: 	defer cancel()
623: 	abortResults := make(chan struct{})
624: 	indices := make([]int, 0, len(shards))
625: 	for i := range shards {
626: 		if shards[i].Phase == QAPhaseCompleted || shards[i].Phase == QAPhaseBlocked {
627: 			continue
628: 		}
629: 		if req.FocusShard != "" && shards[i].ID != req.FocusShard {
630: 			continue
631: 		}
632: 		indices = append(indices, i)
633: 	}
634: 	if req.FocusShard != "" && len(indices) == 0 {
635: 		return shards, state, NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "run", "focused shard is absent or already terminal", nil)
636: 	}
637: 	workers := qaMap.Budgets.ConcurrentInvestigators
638: 	if workers > len(indices) {
639: 		workers = len(indices)
640: 	}
641: 	if workers == 0 {
642: 		return shards, state, nil
643: 	}
644: 	jobs := make(chan int, workers)
645: 	results := make(chan qaShardResult, workers)
646: 	var group sync.WaitGroup
647: 	for i := 0; i < workers; i++ {
648: 		group.Add(1)
649: 		go func() {
650: 			defer group.Done()
651: 			for index := range jobs {
652: 				shard, err := s.runOneQAShardSafely(batchCtx, qaMap, shards[index], target, req.WriterToken)
653: 				select {
654: 				case results <- qaShardResult{shard: shard, err: err}:
655: 				case <-abortResults:
656: 					return
657: 				}
658: 			}
659: 		}()
660: 	}
661: 	go func() {
662: 		defer close(jobs)
663: 		for _, index := range indices {
664: 			select {
665: 			case jobs <- index:
666: 			case <-batchCtx.Done():
667: 				return
668: 			}
669: 		}
670: 	}()
671: 	go func() {
672: 		group.Wait()
673: 		close(results)
674: 	}()
675: 	byID := make(map[string]int, len(shards))
676: 	for i := range shards {
677: 		byID[shards[i].ID] = i
678: 	}
679: 	var publishErr error
680: 	for result := range results {
681: 		if publishErr != nil {
682: 			continue
683: 		}
684: 		index := byID[result.shard.ID]
685: 		if result.err != nil {
686: 			switch {
687: 			case errors.Is(result.err, context.Canceled):
688: 				result.shard.Phase = QAPhaseCancelled
689: 			case errors.Is(result.err, context.DeadlineExceeded):
690: 				result.shard.Phase = QAPhaseInterrupted
691: 			default:
692: 				result.shard.Phase = QAPhaseBlocked
693: 			}
694: 			result.shard.Blocker = qaBlocker(result.err, result.shard.ID)
695: 		}
696: 		shards[index] = result.shard
697: 		state.CompletedShards = countTerminalQAShards(shards)
698: 		state.UpdatedAt = s.now().UTC()
699: 		if err := store.Publish(QAPublication{Shards: []QAShard{result.shard}, State: state, Flow: flow}, req.WriterToken); err != nil {
700: 			publishErr = err
701: 			close(abortResults)
702: 			cancel()
703: 			continue
704: 		}
705: 		emitQA(req.Progress, QAProgress{Phase: state.Phase, ShardID: result.shard.ID, ShardKind: result.shard.Kind, ShardPhase: result.shard.Phase, Event: "shard_terminal", Completed: state.CompletedShards, Total: state.TotalShards, Message: "QA shard reached a terminal state"})
706: 	}
707: 	if publishErr != nil {
708: 		return shards, state, publishErr
709: 	}
710: 	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
711: 		return shards, state, err
712: 	}
713: 	return shards, state, nil
714: }

716: func (s Service) runOneQAShardSafely(ctx context.Context, qaMap QAMap, shard QAShard, target string, token QAWriterToken) (result QAShard, err error) {
717: 	result = shard
718: 	defer func() {
719: 		if recovered := recover(); recovered != nil {
720: 			err = NewQAError(QAErrorRuntimeUnavailable, "investigate shard", "investigator runtime panicked", fmt.Errorf("panic: %v", recovered))
721: 		}
722: 	}()
723: 	return s.runOneQAShard(ctx, qaMap, shard, target, token)
724: }

726: func (s Service) runOneQAShard(ctx context.Context, qaMap QAMap, shard QAShard, target string, token QAWriterToken) (QAShard, error) {
727: 	if err := s.validateCurrentQAMap(qaMap); err != nil {
728: 		return shard, err
729: 	}
730: 	request, err := s.QAInvestigatorRequest(qaMap, shard, target)
731: 	if err != nil {
732: 		return shard, err
733: 	}
734: 	request.Metadata["operation"] = "qa-investigate"
735: 	request.Metadata["task"] = shard.ID
736: 	request.Metadata["operational_attempt"] = token.OperationalAttemptID
737: 	capture := &qaOutputCapture{}
738: 	request.Validation = qaInvestigatorValidationSpec(qaMap.Budgets, capture)
739: 	previousOnEvent := request.OnEvent
740: 	request.OnEvent = func(event pruntime.Event) {
741: 		capture.observe(event.Payload)
742: 		if previousOnEvent != nil {
743: 			previousOnEvent(event)
744: 		}
745: 	}
746: 	before, identityErr := targetIdentity(target)
747: 	if identityErr != nil || before != qaMap.ImplementationFingerprint {
748: 		return shard, NewQAError(QAErrorStaleInput, "investigate shard", "implementation identity no longer matches the QA map", identityErr)
749: 	}
750: 	started := s.now().UTC()
751: 	result, runErr := s.runtime.StartRun(ctx, request)
752: 	if result.TerminalOutput == "" {
753: 		result.TerminalOutput = capture.load()
754: 	}
755: 	completed := s.now().UTC()
756: 	after, afterErr := targetIdentity(target)
757: 	attempt := QAInvestigatorAttempt{ID: fmt.Sprintf("%s/%s/1", token.OperationalAttemptID, shard.ID), Number: 1, StartedAt: started, CompletedAt: &completed, ImplementationBefore: before, ImplementationAfter: after, Usage: qaUsageSummary(result.Usage)}
758: 	if result.Repair.Configured {
759: 		attempt.Repair = &QARepairDiagnostic{Attempted: result.Repair.Attempted, MaxAttempts: result.Repair.MaxAttempts, AttemptCount: result.Repair.AttemptCount, Exhausted: result.Repair.Exhausted, ExhaustedReason: result.Repair.ExhaustedReason, PermissionDenied: result.Repair.PermissionDenied, UnsupportedSameSession: result.Repair.UnsupportedSameSession}
760: 	}
761: 	if result.EstimatedCost != nil {
762: 		attempt.EstimatedCost = &QACostSummary{Amount: result.EstimatedCost.Amount, Currency: result.EstimatedCost.Currency, Estimate: result.EstimatedCost.Estimate}
763: 	}
764: 	if afterErr != nil || after != before {
765: 		attempt.StopReason = "implementation identity drift"
766: 		shard.Attempts = append(shard.Attempts, attempt)
767: 		return shard, NewQAError(QAErrorPermissionDenied, "investigate shard", "implementation identity changed during read-only investigation", afterErr)
768: 	}
769: 	if currentErr := s.validateCurrentQAMap(qaMap); currentErr != nil {
770: 		attempt.StopReason = "governed input drift"
771: 		shard.Attempts = append(shard.Attempts, attempt)
772: 		return shard, currentErr
773: 	}
774: 	if result.Permissions.Mode != "restricted" || result.Permissions.Default != "deny" || result.Permissions.UnsupportedCount != 0 {
775: 		attempt.StopReason = "permission enforcement unavailable"
776: 		shard.Attempts = append(shard.Attempts, attempt)
777: 		return shard, NewQAError(QAErrorPermissionDenied, "investigate shard", "runtime did not enforce restricted default-deny permissions", nil)
778: 	}
779: 	if result.Validation.Configured && !result.Validation.Passed {
780: 		_, diagnostic, decodeErr := decodeQAInvestigatorOutput(result, qaMap.Budgets.ShardOutputBytes)
781: 		attempt.FailureKind, attempt.StopReason, attempt.OutputDiagnostic = "invalid_output", "investigator output repair exhausted", &diagnostic
782: 		shard.Attempts = append(shard.Attempts, attempt)
783: 		detail := fmt.Sprintf("investigator output repair exhausted after %d repair attempts", result.Repair.AttemptCount)
784: 		return shard, NewQAError(QAErrorBudgetExhausted, "investigate shard", detail, decodeErr)
785: 	}
786: 	if runErr != nil {
787: 		attempt.FailureKind, attempt.Retryable = classifyQARuntimeFailure(result, runErr)
788: 		attempt.StopReason = "runtime policy exhausted"
789: 		shard.Attempts = append(shard.Attempts, attempt)
790: 		if errors.Is(runErr, context.Canceled) || errors.Is(runErr, context.DeadlineExceeded) {
791: 			return shard, runErr
792: 		}
793: 		return shard, NewQAError(QAErrorRuntimeUnavailable, "investigate shard", "runtime resilience policy exhausted", runErr)
794: 	}
795: 	if result.Usage.TurnsKnown && result.Usage.Turns > int64(qaMap.Budgets.IterationsPerAttempt) {
796: 		attempt.StopReason = "investigator iteration limit exceeded"
797: 		shard.Attempts = append(shard.Attempts, attempt)
798: 		return shard, NewQAError(QAErrorBudgetExhausted, "investigate shard", fmt.Sprintf("investigator used %d turns; limit is %d", result.Usage.Turns, qaMap.Budgets.IterationsPerAttempt), nil)
799: 	}
800: 	output, diagnostic, decodeErr := decodeQAInvestigatorOutput(result, qaMap.Budgets.ShardOutputBytes)
801: 	if decodeErr != nil {
802: 		// Alternate runtimes may ignore ValidationSpec. Fail closed without
803: 		// adding a second product-owned retry loop.
804: 		attempt.FailureKind, attempt.StopReason, attempt.OutputDiagnostic = "invalid_output", "investigator output rejected", &diagnostic
805: 		shard.Attempts = append(shard.Attempts, attempt)
806: 		return shard, NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "investigate shard", "runtime returned invalid investigator output without validation repair metadata", decodeErr)
807: 	}
808: 	attempt.StopReason = "terminal investigator output accepted"
809: 	if len(output.Theories) > qaMap.Budgets.TheoriesPerShard || len(output.Context) > qaMap.Budgets.ContextExpansions || len(output.Checks) > qaMap.Budgets.CommandsPerAttempt {
810: 		return shard, NewQAError(QAErrorBudgetExhausted, "investigate shard", "investigator output exceeds map-owned limits", nil)
811: 	}
812: 	attempt.ContextRequests = append([]QAContextRequest(nil), output.Context...)
813: 	attempt.Evidence = append([]QAEvidenceSummary(nil), output.Evidence...)
814: 	for _, contextRequest := range attempt.ContextRequests {
815: 		if contextRequest.Approved {
816: 			return shard, NewQAError(QAErrorPermissionDenied, "investigate shard", "runtime cannot self-approve context expansion", nil)
817: 		}
818: 		if len(contextRequest.Paths) > qaMap.Budgets.PathsPerExpansion {
819: 			return shard, NewQAError(QAErrorBudgetExhausted, "investigate shard", "context request exceeds path limit", nil)
820: 		}
821: 		for _, path := range contextRequest.Paths {
822: 			if err := validateQAPath(path); err != nil {
823: 				return shard, NewQAError(QAErrorPermissionDenied, "investigate shard", err.Error(), err)
824: 			}
825: 		}
826: 	}
827: 	checks, err := ApprovedQAChecks(target, qaMap.Coverage.ChangedPaths, qaMap.Budgets)
828: 	if err != nil {
829: 		return shard, err
830: 	}
831: 	checkByID := map[string]QACheckDescriptor{}
832: 	for _, descriptor := range checks {
833: 		checkByID[descriptor.ID] = descriptor
834: 	}
835: 	for _, requested := range output.Checks {
836: 		descriptor, ok := checkByID[requested.ID]
837: 		if !ok {
838: 			return shard, NewQAError(QAErrorPermissionDenied, "investigate shard", "runtime requested a check outside the map-owned catalog", nil)
839: 		}
840: 		summary, checkErr := s.RunApprovedQACheck(ctx, qaMap, descriptor, requested)
841: 		attempt.Commands = append(attempt.Commands, summary)
842: 		if checkErr != nil {
843: 			return shard, checkErr
844: 		}
845: 	}
846: 	theories := make([]QATheory, 0, len(output.Theories))
847: 	for _, draft := range output.Theories {
848: 		identity := QATheoryIdentity{Claim: draft.Claim, Basis: draft.Basis, VerificationSurface: draft.VerificationSurface, ExpectationRefs: normalizeQAStrings(draft.ExpectationRefs)}
849: 		id, idErr := NewQATheoryID(qaMap.Project, qaMap.Sprint, shard.ID, identity)
850: 		if idErr != nil {
851: 			return shard, idErr
852: 		}
853: 		theory := QATheory{SchemaVersion: QASchemaVersion, ID: id, ShardID: shard.ID, Claim: draft.Claim, Basis: draft.Basis, VerificationSurface: draft.VerificationSurface, ExpectationRefs: identity.ExpectationRefs, SeverityIfConfirmed: draft.SeverityIfConfirmed, ConfirmationCondition: draft.ConfirmationCondition, RefutationCondition: draft.RefutationCondition, InconclusiveCondition: draft.InconclusiveCondition, SafeEvidenceStrategy: draft.SafeEvidenceStrategy, ImplementationFingerprint: attempt.ImplementationBefore, AttemptHistory: append(append([]QAInvestigatorAttempt(nil), shard.Attempts...), attempt), Evidence: append([]QAEvidenceSummary(nil), output.Evidence...), Outcome: draft.Outcome, OutcomeReason: draft.OutcomeReason}
854: 		if err := ValidateQATheory(theory); err != nil {
855: 			return shard, NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "investigate shard", err.Error(), err)
856: 		}
857: 		theories = append(theories, theory)
858: 	}
859: 	if len(theories) == 0 {
860: 		return shard, NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "investigate shard", "investigator returned no falsifiable theories", nil)
861: 	}
862: 	if err := s.validateCurrentQAMap(qaMap); err != nil {
863: 		return shard, err
864: 	}
865: 	sort.Slice(theories, func(i, j int) bool { return theories[i].ID < theories[j].ID })
866: 	shard.Attempts = append(shard.Attempts, attempt)
867: 	shard.Theories = theories
868: 	shard.Phase = QAPhaseCompleted
869: 	shard.Blocker = nil
870: 	return shard, nil
871: }

878: 		return r
879: 	}, value)
880: 	if len(value) > 512 {
881: 		value = value[:512]
882: 	}
883: 	return value

903: func decodeQAInvestigatorOutput(result pruntime.Result, limit int) (qaInvestigatorOutput, QAOutputDiagnostic, error) {
904: 	content := result.TerminalOutput
905: 	source := "terminal_output"
906: 	if content == "" {
907: 		source = "event"
908: 		for i := len(result.Events) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
909: 			if value, ok := result.Events[i].Payload["content"].(string); ok && value != "" {
910: 				content = value
911: 				break
912: 			}
913: 		}
914: 	}
915: 	diagnostic := QAOutputDiagnostic{Source: source, OutputBytes: len(content), EventCount: len(result.Events), Status: result.Status, Session: result.SessionID != "", UsageKnown: result.Usage.InputTokensKnown || result.Usage.OutputTokensKnown || result.Usage.TotalTokensKnown || result.Usage.TurnsKnown}
916: 	if len(content) == 0 || len(content) > limit {
917: 		diagnostic.Kind = "empty"
918: 		detail := "terminal output is empty"
919: 		if len(content) > limit {
920: 			diagnostic.Kind, detail = "too_large", "terminal output exceeds the shard output limit"
921: 		}
922: 		diagnostic.Detail = detail
923: 		return qaInvestigatorOutput{}, diagnostic, NewQAError(QAErrorBudgetExhausted, "decode investigator", detail, nil)
924: 	}
925: 	decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewBufferString(content))
926: 	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
927: 	var output qaInvestigatorOutput
928: 	if err := decoder.Decode(&output); err != nil {
929: 		diagnostic.Kind, diagnostic.Detail = qaJSONFailureKind(err), qaSafeDiagnostic(err.Error())
930: 		return qaInvestigatorOutput{}, diagnostic, NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "decode investigator", "terminal output is not one strict QA JSON object", err)
931: 	}
932: 	var trailing any
933: 	if err := decoder.Decode(&trailing); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
934: 		diagnostic.Kind, diagnostic.Detail = "trailing_json", "terminal output has trailing JSON"
935: 		return qaInvestigatorOutput{}, diagnostic, NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "decode investigator", "terminal output has trailing JSON", err)
936: 	}
937: 	if output.SchemaVersion != QASchemaVersion {
938: 		diagnostic.Kind, diagnostic.Detail = "schema_version", fmt.Sprintf("unsupported investigator schema version %d", output.SchemaVersion)
939: 		return qaInvestigatorOutput{}, diagnostic, NewQAError(QAErrorUnknownSchema, "decode investigator", diagnostic.Detail, nil)
940: 	}
941: 	if output.Theories == nil || output.Evidence == nil || output.Context == nil || output.Checks == nil {
942: 		diagnostic.Kind, diagnostic.Detail = "missing_field", "all five top-level fields are required and array fields cannot be null"
943: 		return qaInvestigatorOutput{}, diagnostic, NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "decode investigator", diagnostic.Detail, nil)
944: 	}
945: 	return output, QAOutputDiagnostic{}, nil
946: }

948: func qaJSONFailureKind(err error) string {
949: 	message := err.Error()
950: 	switch {
951: 	case strings.Contains(message, "unknown field"):
952: 		return "unknown_field"
953: 	case strings.Contains(message, "cannot unmarshal"):
954: 		return "type_mismatch"
955: 	default:
956: 		return "syntax"
957: 	}
958: }

960: func terminalQAState(state QAState, err error, now time.Time) QAState {

386: 	emitQA(req.Progress, QAProgress{Phase: QAPhaseSynthesizing, Event: "synthesis_started", Completed: state.CompletedShards, Total: state.TotalShards, Message: "QA synthesis started"})
387: 	synthesis, err := SynthesizeQA(mapResult.Map, shards)
388: 	if err != nil {
389: 		return s.publishTerminalQAFailure(store, flow, mapResult.Map, shards, state, req.WriterToken, err)
390: 	}
391: 	if len(synthesis.FollowUpShards) > 0 {
392: 		follow := append([]QAShard(nil), synthesis.FollowUpShards...)
393: 		state.TotalShards += len(follow)
394: 		shards = append(shards, follow...)
395: 		shards, state, runErr = s.runQAShardBatch(runCtx, store, flow, mapResult.Map, manifest.Target, shards, state, req)
396: 		if runErr != nil {
397: 			state = terminalQAState(state, runErr, s.now().UTC())
398: 			if publishErr := store.Publish(QAPublication{State: state, Flow: flow}, req.WriterToken); publishErr != nil {
399: 				return QARunResult{}, errors.Join(runErr, publishErr)
400: 			}
401: 			return QARunResult{Project: sp.Project, Sprint: sp.Slug, State: state, Map: mapResult.Map, Shards: shards}, runErr
402: 		}
403: 		synthesis, err = SynthesizeQA(mapResult.Map, shards)
404: 		if err != nil {
405: 			return s.publishTerminalQAFailure(store, flow, mapResult.Map, shards, state, req.WriterToken, err)
406: 		}
407: 	}
408: 	if err := hydrateQASynthesisFollowUps(&synthesis, shards); err != nil {
409: 		return s.publishTerminalQAFailure(store, flow, mapResult.Map, shards, state, req.WriterToken, err)
410: 	}
411: 	state.OutcomeCounts = cloneQAOutcomeCounts(synthesis.OutcomeCounts)
412: 	state.Phase = QAPhaseCompleted
413: 	state.Run.Lifecycle = QARunTerminal
414: 	state.Run.TerminalResult = QATerminalCompleted
415: 	state.NextAction = synthesis.NextAction
416: 	state.UpdatedAt = s.now().UTC()
417: 	var evidencePublication *QAEvidencePublication
418: 	if req.EvidenceProducing {
419: 		bundle, assessment, evidenceErr := s.buildQAEvidencePublication(runCtx, sp, mapResult.Map, manifest.Target, shards, req.Progress)
420: 		if evidenceErr != nil {
421: 			return s.publishTerminalQAFailure(store, flow, mapResult.Map, shards, state, req.WriterToken, evidenceErr)
422: 		}
423: 		evidencePublication = &bundle
424: 		state.NextAction = assessment.NextAction
425: 		state.CanonicalAssessment = assessment.Assessment
426: 		if assessment.Assessment == AssessmentFail || assessment.Assessment == AssessmentBlocked || assessment.Assessment == AssessmentIncomplete {
427: 			state.Phase = QAPhaseBlocked
428: 			state.Run.TerminalResult = QATerminalBlocked
429: 		}
430: 	}
431: 	if err := store.Publish(QAPublication{Shards: shards, Synthesis: &synthesis, State: state, Flow: flow, Evidence: evidencePublication}, req.WriterToken); err != nil {
432: 		return QARunResult{}, err
433: 	}
434: 	loaded, err := store.LoadState()
435: 	if err != nil {
436: 		return QARunResult{}, err
437: 	}
438: 	emitQA(req.Progress, QAProgress{Phase: loaded.Phase, Event: "investigation_complete", Completed: loaded.CompletedShards, Total: loaded.TotalShards, Message: "QA investigation complete"})
439: 	return QARunResult{Project: sp.Project, Sprint: sp.Slug, State: loaded, Map: mapResult.Map, Shards: shards, Synthesis: synthesis}, nil
440: }

448: 	admission := QAAdmission{
449: 		ReviewCurrent: status.Review.Fresh, ReviewVerdict: status.Review.Verdict,
450: 		SmokeCurrent: status.Smoke.Fresh, SmokeVerdict: status.Smoke.Verdict, ContainingSmoke: status.Smoke.Fresh,
451: 		ReadOnlyProofs: []string{"deterministic_map", "bounded_investigation", "synthesis"}, MapComplete: len(qaMap.Coverage.BlockedPaths) == 0 && len(qaMap.Coverage.PrimaryOwners) == len(qaMap.Coverage.ChangedPaths),
452: 		IsolationProven:     capabilities.NativeProtectedRootDeny && capabilities.DescendantCleanup && capabilities.WorkspaceRemoval,

457: 	}
458: 	limits := pprocess.IsolationLimits{MaxFiles: qaMap.Budgets.TreeFiles, MaxBytes: qaMap.Budgets.TreeBytes, MaxFileSize: qaMap.Budgets.FileBytes, Timeout: qaMap.Budgets.ShardTimeout}

462: 	}
463: 	mapFingerprint, err := fingerprintQAValue(qaMap)
464: 	if err != nil {
465: 		return QAEvidencePublication{}, QAAssessmentRecord{}, err
466: 	}
467: 	workspaceParent, err := os.MkdirTemp("", "ultraplan-qa-evidence-")
468: 	if err != nil {
469: 		return QAEvidencePublication{}, QAAssessmentRecord{}, NewQAError(QAErrorPermissionDenied, "admission", "cannot create the private QA workspace parent", err)
470: 	}
471: 	defer os.RemoveAll(workspaceParent)
472: 	plans := make([]QAEvidencePlan, 0, len(shards))
473: 	records := make([]QAEvidenceRecord, 0, len(shards))
474: 	candidates := make([]QAIssueCandidate, 0)
475: 	evaluators := make([]QAModelObservation, 0)
476: 	completedEvidence := 0
477: 	for _, shard := range shards {
478: 		if shard.Phase != QAPhaseCompleted {
479: 			continue
480: 		}
481: 		approvedPaths := normalizeQAStrings(append(append([]string(nil), shard.ChangedPaths...), shard.ContextPaths...))
482: 		if len(approvedPaths) == 0 {
483: 			continue
484: 		}
485: 		emitQA(progress, QAProgress{Phase: QAPhaseRunning, Event: "evidence_started", ShardID: shard.ID, Completed: completedEvidence, Total: len(shards), Message: "Running isolated evidence check"})
486: 		descriptors, checkErr := ApprovedQAChecks(target, shard.ChangedPaths, qaMap.Budgets)
487: 		if checkErr != nil {
488: 			return QAEvidencePublication{}, QAAssessmentRecord{}, checkErr
489: 		}
490: 		descriptor := QACheckDescriptor{Executable: "true", Timeout: qaMap.Budgets.CommandTimeout, OutputLimit: qaMap.Budgets.CommandOutputBytes}
491: 		if len(descriptors) > 0 {
492: 			descriptor = descriptors[0]
493: 		}
494: 		executable, lookupErr := exec.LookPath(descriptor.Executable)
495: 		if lookupErr != nil {
496: 			return QAEvidencePublication{}, QAAssessmentRecord{}, NewQAError(QAErrorAdmissionBlocked, "plan evidence", "an approved check executable is unavailable", lookupErr)
497: 		}
498: 		plan, planErr := FreezeQAEvidencePlan(sp.Project, sp.Slug, QAEvidencePlan{
499: 			AttemptID: qaMap.SemanticAttemptID, ShardID: shard.ID, ExpectationRefs: shard.ExpectationRefs,
500: 			Kind: QACheckFact, ConfirmationCondition: "approved check exits successfully", RefutationCondition: "approved check exits unsuccessfully", InconclusiveCondition: "approved check is incomplete",
501: 			ApprovedPaths: approvedPaths, Executable: executable, Args: append([]string(nil), descriptor.Args...), Timeout: descriptor.Timeout, OutputLimit: descriptor.OutputLimit,
502: 			CleanupRequired: true, GovernedInputFingerprint: qaMap.GovernedInputFingerprint, ImplementationFingerprint: qaMap.ImplementationFingerprint, MapFingerprint: mapFingerprint,
503: 		}, qaMap.Budgets, s.now().UTC())
504: 		if planErr != nil {

506: 		}
507: 		record, runErr := RunQAInvestigation(ctx, QAInvestigationRequest{Project: sp.Project, Sprint: sp.Slug, TargetRoot: target, WorkspaceParent: workspaceParent, ProtectedRoots: []string{s.root, target}, Plan: plan, Budgets: qaMap.Budgets, ExpectedTargetID: targetIdentity.Digest, Now: s.now})
508: 		if runErr != nil {

510: 		}
511: 		if record.Outcome == QAEvidenceFail {
512: 			observations, finalOutcome, evaluationErr := s.evaluateFailedEvidence(ctx, sp, record, plan)
513: 			evaluators = append(evaluators, observations...)
514: 			if evaluationErr != nil {
515: 				record.Outcome, record.ReasonCode = QAEvidenceBlocked, "evaluator_incomplete"
516: 			} else {
517: 				record.Outcome = finalOutcome
518: 				record.Repeatable = finalOutcome == QAEvidenceFail
519: 				record.ReasonCode = "failed_shard_evaluated"
520: 			}
521: 		}
522: 		plans, records = append(plans, plan), append(records, record)
523: 		completedEvidence++
524: 		emitQA(progress, QAProgress{Phase: QAPhaseRunning, Event: "evidence_completed", ShardID: shard.ID, Completed: completedEvidence, Total: len(shards), Message: "Isolated evidence check complete"})
525: 		if record.Outcome == QAEvidenceFail {
526: 			title, claim, location := "Approved QA check failed", "an approved check failed in the isolated copy", approvedPaths[0]
527: 			if len(shard.Theories) > 0 {
528: 				title, claim, location = shard.Theories[0].Claim, shard.Theories[0].Claim, shard.Theories[0].VerificationSurface
529: 			}
530: 			candidates = append(candidates, QAIssueCandidate{Title: title, Claim: claim, IssueClass: "behavior", Severity: "medium", Location: location, EvidenceIDs: []string{record.ID}, RepairEligible: true, RegressionCandidate: true})
531: 		}
532: 	}
533: 	adjudication, err := AdjudicateQA(QAAdjudicationRequest{Project: sp.Project, Sprint: sp.Slug, AttemptID: qaMap.SemanticAttemptID, MapFingerprint: mapFingerprint, Plans: plans, Evidence: records, Candidates: candidates, Evaluators: evaluators, Budgets: qaMap.Budgets, Now: s.now().UTC()})
534: 	if err != nil {
535: 		return QAEvidencePublication{}, QAAssessmentRecord{}, err
536: 	}
537: 	assessmentValue, nextAction := DeriveQAAssessment(status.Review, records, adjudication, &status.Smoke, nil)
538: 	assessmentID, err := NewQAV2ID("assessment", sp.Project, sp.Slug, qaMap.SemanticAttemptID, struct {
539: 		Assessment OverallAssessment
540: 		Evidence   []string
541: 		Issues     int
542: 	}{assessmentValue, adjudication.AcceptedIDs, len(adjudication.Issues)})
543: 	if err != nil {
544: 		return QAEvidencePublication{}, QAAssessmentRecord{}, err
545: 	}
546: 	assessment := QAAssessmentRecord{SchemaVersion: QAEvidenceSchemaVersion, ID: assessmentID, AttemptID: qaMap.SemanticAttemptID, ReviewVerdict: ReviewVerdict(status.Review.Verdict), ReviewFingerprint: status.Review.InputFingerprint, SmokeVerdict: SmokeVerdict(status.Smoke.Verdict), SmokeRunID: status.Smoke.RunID, Assessment: assessmentValue, EvidenceTotal: len(records), RejectedTotal: len(adjudication.Rejected), IssueTotal: len(adjudication.Issues), NextAction: nextAction, CompletedAt: s.now().UTC()}
547: 	report, err := RenderQAReport(sp.Project, sp.Slug, qaMap.GovernedInputFingerprint, records, adjudication, assessment)
548: 	if err != nil {
549: 		return QAEvidencePublication{}, QAAssessmentRecord{}, err
550: 	}
551: 	return QAEvidencePublication{Plans: plans, Records: records, Adjudication: &adjudication, Assessment: &assessment, Report: []byte(report), Budgets: qaMap.Budgets}, assessment, nil
552: }

562: func hydrateQASynthesisFollowUps(synthesis *QASynthesis, shards []QAShard) error {
563: 	byID := make(map[string]QAShard, len(shards))
564: 	for _, shard := range shards {
565: 		byID[shard.ID] = shard
566: 	}
567: 	for i := range synthesis.FollowUpShards {
568: 		current, ok := byID[synthesis.FollowUpShards[i].ID]
569: 		if !ok || (current.Phase != QAPhaseCompleted && current.Phase != QAPhaseBlocked) {
570: 			return NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "synthesize", "a proposed follow-up shard did not reach a retained terminal state", nil)
571: 		}
572: 		synthesis.FollowUpShards[i] = current
573: 	}
574: 	return nil
575: }

577: func (s Service) prepareQAAttempt(store QAStore, flow FlowState, qaMap QAMap, req QARunRequest, settings QASettings) (QAState, []QAShard, error) {
578: 	now := s.now().UTC()
579: 	if req.Resume {
580: 		prior, err := store.LoadState()
581: 		if err == nil && prior.CurrentAttemptID == qaMap.SemanticAttemptID && prior.Map != nil {
582: 			shards := append([]QAShard(nil), qaMap.Shards...)
583: 			for i := range shards {
584: 				loaded, loadErr := store.LoadShard(qaMap.SemanticAttemptID, shards[i].ID)
585: 				if loadErr == nil && (loaded.Phase == QAPhaseCompleted || loaded.Phase == QAPhaseBlocked) {
586: 					shards[i] = loaded
587: 				}
588: 			}
589: 			prior.Run = qaRunCorrelation(req.WriterToken, QARunClaimed)
590: 			prior.Phase = QAPhaseQueued
591: 			prior.Blocker = nil
592: 			prior.Cancellation = QACancellation{}
593: 			prior.CompletedShards = countTerminalQAShards(shards)
594: 			prior.TotalShards = len(shards)
595: 			prior.NextAction = "Resume incomplete shards from the current semantic attempt."
596: 			prior.UpdatedAt = now
597: 			if err := store.Publish(QAPublication{State: prior, Flow: flow}, req.WriterToken); err != nil {
598: 				return QAState{}, nil, err
599: 			}
600: 			return prior, shards, nil
601: 		}
602: 	}
603: 	state := QAState{SchemaVersion: QASchemaVersion, Project: qaMap.Project, Sprint: qaMap.Sprint, Phase: QAPhaseMapped,
604: 		Freshness:        QAFreshness{Current: true, GovernedInputFingerprint: qaMap.GovernedInputFingerprint, ImplementationFingerprint: qaMap.ImplementationFingerprint, ReviewFingerprint: qaMap.ReviewFingerprint, PolicyFingerprint: qaMap.PolicyFingerprint},
605: 		CurrentAttemptID: qaMap.SemanticAttemptID, CompletedShards: countTerminalQAShards(qaMap.Shards), TotalShards: len(qaMap.Shards), Run: qaRunCorrelation(req.WriterToken, QARunClaimed), NextAction: "Run the mapped read-only QA shards.", UpdatedAt: now}
606: 	shards := append([]QAShard(nil), qaMap.Shards...)
607: 	if err := store.Publish(QAPublication{Map: &qaMap, Shards: shards, State: state, Flow: flow}, req.WriterToken); err != nil {
608: 		return QAState{}, nil, err
609: 	}
610: 	loaded, err := store.LoadState()
611: 	if err != nil {
612: 		return QAState{}, nil, err
613: 	}
614: 	if err := store.PruneAttempts(qaMap.SemanticAttemptID, settings.Budgets.RetainedAttempts); err != nil {
615: 		return QAState{}, nil, err
616: 	}
617: 	return loaded, shards, nil
618: }

620: func (s Service) runQAShardBatch(ctx context.Context, store QAStore, flow FlowState, qaMap QAMap, target string, shards []QAShard, state QAState, req QARunRequest) ([]QAShard, QAState, error) {
621: 	batchCtx, cancel := context.WithCancel(ctx)
622: 	defer cancel()
623: 	abortResults := make(chan struct{})
624: 	indices := make([]int, 0, len(shards))
625: 	for i := range shards {
626: 		if shards[i].Phase == QAPhaseCompleted || shards[i].Phase == QAPhaseBlocked {
627: 			continue
628: 		}
629: 		if req.FocusShard != "" && shards[i].ID != req.FocusShard {
630: 			continue
631: 		}
632: 		indices = append(indices, i)
633: 	}
634: 	if req.FocusShard != "" && len(indices) == 0 {
635: 		return shards, state, NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "run", "focused shard is absent or already terminal", nil)
636: 	}
637: 	workers := qaMap.Budgets.ConcurrentInvestigators
638: 	if workers > len(indices) {
639: 		workers = len(indices)
640: 	}
641: 	if workers == 0 {
642: 		return shards, state, nil
643: 	}
644: 	jobs := make(chan int, workers)
645: 	results := make(chan qaShardResult, workers)
646: 	var group sync.WaitGroup
647: 	for i := 0; i < workers; i++ {
648: 		group.Add(1)
649: 		go func() {
650: 			defer group.Done()
651: 			for index := range jobs {
652: 				shard, err := s.runOneQAShardSafely(batchCtx, qaMap, shards[index], target, req.WriterToken)
653: 				select {
654: 				case results <- qaShardResult{shard: shard, err: err}:
655: 				case <-abortResults:
656: 					return
657: 				}
658: 			}
659: 		}()
660: 	}
661: 	go func() {
662: 		defer close(jobs)
663: 		for _, index := range indices {
664: 			select {
665: 			case jobs <- index:
666: 			case <-batchCtx.Done():
667: 				return
668: 			}
669: 		}
670: 	}()
671: 	go func() {
672: 		group.Wait()
673: 		close(results)
674: 	}()
675: 	byID := make(map[string]int, len(shards))
676: 	for i := range shards {
677: 		byID[shards[i].ID] = i
678: 	}
679: 	var publishErr error
680: 	for result := range results {
681: 		if publishErr != nil {
682: 			continue
683: 		}
684: 		index := byID[result.shard.ID]
685: 		if result.err != nil {
686: 			switch {
687: 			case errors.Is(result.err, context.Canceled):
688: 				result.shard.Phase = QAPhaseCancelled
689: 			case errors.Is(result.err, context.DeadlineExceeded):
690: 				result.shard.Phase = QAPhaseInterrupted
691: 			default:
692: 				result.shard.Phase = QAPhaseBlocked
693: 			}
694: 			result.shard.Blocker = qaBlocker(result.err, result.shard.ID)
695: 		}
696: 		shards[index] = result.shard
697: 		state.CompletedShards = countTerminalQAShards(shards)
698: 		state.UpdatedAt = s.now().UTC()
699: 		if err := store.Publish(QAPublication{Shards: []QAShard{result.shard}, State: state, Flow: flow}, req.WriterToken); err != nil {
700: 			publishErr = err
701: 			close(abortResults)
702: 			cancel()
703: 			continue
704: 		}
705: 		emitQA(req.Progress, QAProgress{Phase: state.Phase, ShardID: result.shard.ID, ShardKind: result.shard.Kind, ShardPhase: result.shard.Phase, Event: "shard_terminal", Completed: state.CompletedShards, Total: state.TotalShards, Message: "QA shard reached a terminal state"})
706: 	}
707: 	if publishErr != nil {
708: 		return shards, state, publishErr
709: 	}
710: 	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
711: 		return shards, state, err
712: 	}
713: 	return shards, state, nil
714: }

716: func (s Service) runOneQAShardSafely(ctx context.Context, qaMap QAMap, shard QAShard, target string, token QAWriterToken) (result QAShard, err error) {
717: 	result = shard
718: 	defer func() {
719: 		if recovered := recover(); recovered != nil {
720: 			err = NewQAError(QAErrorRuntimeUnavailable, "investigate shard", "investigator runtime panicked", fmt.Errorf("panic: %v", recovered))
721: 		}
722: 	}()
723: 	return s.runOneQAShard(ctx, qaMap, shard, target, token)
724: }

726: func (s Service) runOneQAShard(ctx context.Context, qaMap QAMap, shard QAShard, target string, token QAWriterToken) (QAShard, error) {
727: 	if err := s.validateCurrentQAMap(qaMap); err != nil {
728: 		return shard, err
729: 	}
730: 	request, err := s.QAInvestigatorRequest(qaMap, shard, target)
731: 	if err != nil {
732: 		return shard, err
733: 	}
734: 	request.Metadata["operation"] = "qa-investigate"
735: 	request.Metadata["task"] = shard.ID
736: 	request.Metadata["operational_attempt"] = token.OperationalAttemptID
737: 	capture := &qaOutputCapture{}
738: 	request.Validation = qaInvestigatorValidationSpec(qaMap.Budgets, capture)
739: 	previousOnEvent := request.OnEvent
740: 	request.OnEvent = func(event pruntime.Event) {
741: 		capture.observe(event.Payload)
742: 		if previousOnEvent != nil {
743: 			previousOnEvent(event)
744: 		}
745: 	}
746: 	before, identityErr := targetIdentity(target)
747: 	if identityErr != nil || before != qaMap.ImplementationFingerprint {
748: 		return shard, NewQAError(QAErrorStaleInput, "investigate shard", "implementation identity no longer matches the QA map", identityErr)
749: 	}
750: 	started := s.now().UTC()
751: 	result, runErr := s.runtime.StartRun(ctx, request)
752: 	if result.TerminalOutput == "" {
753: 		result.TerminalOutput = capture.load()
754: 	}
755: 	completed := s.now().UTC()
756: 	after, afterErr := targetIdentity(target)
757: 	attempt := QAInvestigatorAttempt{ID: fmt.Sprintf("%s/%s/1", token.OperationalAttemptID, shard.ID), Number: 1, StartedAt: started, CompletedAt: &completed, ImplementationBefore: before, ImplementationAfter: after, Usage: qaUsageSummary(result.Usage)}
758: 	if result.Repair.Configured {
759: 		attempt.Repair = &QARepairDiagnostic{Attempted: result.Repair.Attempted, MaxAttempts: result.Repair.MaxAttempts, AttemptCount: result.Repair.AttemptCount, Exhausted: result.Repair.Exhausted, ExhaustedReason: result.Repair.ExhaustedReason, PermissionDenied: result.Repair.PermissionDenied, UnsupportedSameSession: result.Repair.UnsupportedSameSession}
760: 	}
761: 	if result.EstimatedCost != nil {
762: 		attempt.EstimatedCost = &QACostSummary{Amount: result.EstimatedCost.Amount, Currency: result.EstimatedCost.Currency, Estimate: result.EstimatedCost.Estimate}
763: 	}
764: 	if afterErr != nil || after != before {
765: 		attempt.StopReason = "implementation identity drift"
766: 		shard.Attempts = append(shard.Attempts, attempt)
767: 		return shard, NewQAError(QAErrorPermissionDenied, "investigate shard", "implementation identity changed during read-only investigation", afterErr)
768: 	}
769: 	if currentErr := s.validateCurrentQAMap(qaMap); currentErr != nil {
770: 		attempt.StopReason = "governed input drift"
771: 		shard.Attempts = append(shard.Attempts, attempt)
772: 		return shard, currentErr
773: 	}
774: 	if result.Permissions.Mode != "restricted" || result.Permissions.Default != "deny" || result.Permissions.UnsupportedCount != 0 {
775: 		attempt.StopReason = "permission enforcement unavailable"
776: 		shard.Attempts = append(shard.Attempts, attempt)

Interesting candidate defects at freeze:

**Candidate A: Follow-up shard budget bypass / unbounded loop?** At freeze lines 391-407: after first synthesis, if `len(synthesis.FollowUpShards) > 0`, ALL follow-up shards are appended and run. Then re-synthesize. The second SynthesizeQA call includes the follow-up shards now in `shards`. Can the second synthesis propose NEW follow-ups that never get run? Yes — but then `hydrateQASynthesisFollowUps` requires each follow-up in synthesis.FollowUpShards to have reached terminal state among shards; new ones weren't run → hydrate fails → publishTerminalQAFailure → blocked attempt. Hmm wait: re-synthesis at line 403 produces a fresh synthesis over map+all-shards. Its FollowUpShards may include the just-run follow-ups AND new candidates derived from cross_shard/inconclusive theories of the newly completed follow-up shards. Those new ones are not in shards → hydrate error → whole attempt fails as Blocked even though everything else succeeded. Is that reachable? After running batch #2, the re-synthesis includes theories from follow-up shards; if those theories are cross-shard or inconclusive... 44: // VerificationBytes returns the retained private QA footprint without
45: // following symbolic links.
46: func (store QAStore) VerificationBytes() (int64, error) {
47: 	root, err := store.resolve(filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Join("projects", store.sprint.Project, "sprints", store.sprint.Slug, "verification")))
48: 	if err != nil {
49: 		return 0, err
50: 	}
51: 	var total int64
52: 	err = filepath.WalkDir(root, func(path string, entry fs.DirEntry, walkErr error) error {
53: 		if errors.Is(walkErr, fs.ErrNotExist) {
54: 			return nil
55: 		}
56: 		if walkErr != nil {
57: 			return walkErr
58: 		}
59: 		info, infoErr := entry.Info()
60: 		if infoErr != nil {
61: 			return infoErr
62: 		}
63: 		if info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
64: 			return NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "measure state", "QA state contains a symbolic link", nil)
65: 		}
66: 		if info.Mode().IsRegular() {
67: 			total += info.Size()
68: 		}
69: 		return nil
70: 	})
71: 	if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
72: 		return 0, nil
73: 	}
74: 	if err != nil {
75: 		return 0, NewQAError(QAErrorPersistenceFailure, "measure state", "cannot measure retained QA state", err)
76: 	}
77: 	return total, nil
78: }

80: // PruneAttempts keeps the newest bounded set plus the protected current
81: // semantic attempt. It removes only validated attempt directories.
82: func (store QAStore) PruneAttempts(protected string, retain int) error {
83: 	if retain <= 0 {
84: 		return NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "prune attempts", "retention limit must be positive", nil)
85: 	}
86: 	root, err := store.resolve(filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Join("projects", store.sprint.Project, "sprints", store.sprint.Slug, "verification", "attempts")))
87: 	if err != nil {
88: 		return err
89: 	}
90: 	entries, err := os.ReadDir(root)
91: 	if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
92: 		return nil
93: 	}
94: 	if err != nil {
95: 		return NewQAError(QAErrorPersistenceFailure, "prune attempts", "cannot list retained attempts", err)
96: 	}
97: 	type candidate struct {
98: 		name string
99: 		path string
100: 		mod  int64
101: 	}
102: 	values := make([]candidate, 0, len(entries))
103: 	for _, entry := range entries {
104: 		if !entry.IsDir() || !validQAIDKind(entry.Name(), "attempt") {
105: 			return NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "prune attempts", "attempt storage contains an invalid entry", nil)
106: 		}
107: 		info, infoErr := entry.Info()
108: 		if infoErr != nil || info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
109: 			return NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "prune attempts", "attempt storage contains an unsafe entry", infoErr)
110: 		}
111: 		values = append(values, candidate{name: entry.Name(), path: filepath.Join(root, entry.Name()), mod: info.ModTime().UnixNano()})
112: 	}
113: 	sort.Slice(values, func(i, j int) bool {
114: 		if values[i].mod == values[j].mod {
115: 			return values[i].name > values[j].name
116: 		}
117: 		return values[i].mod > values[j].mod
118: 	})
119: 	keep := map[string]bool{}
120: 	for _, value := range values {
121: 		if value.name == protected {
122: 			keep[value.name] = true
123: 			break
124: 		}
125: 	}
126: 	for _, value := range values {
127: 		if keep[value.name] || len(keep) < retain {
128: 			keep[value.name] = true
129: 			continue
130: 		}
131: 		if err := os.RemoveAll(value.path); err != nil {
132: 			return NewQAError(QAErrorPersistenceFailure, "prune attempts", "cannot remove an expired QA attempt", err)
133: 		}
134: 	}
135: 	return nil
136: }

211: func (store QAStore) resolve(rel string) (string, error) {
212: 	full, err := resolveSprintContained(store.root, store.sprint, rel)
213: 	if err != nil {
214: 		return "", NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "resolve path", "QA path escapes the selected sprint", err)
215: 	}
216: 	sprintRoot, err := resolveSprintContained(store.root, store.sprint, filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Join("projects", store.sprint.Project, "sprints", store.sprint.Slug)))
217: 	if err != nil {
218: 		return "", err
219: 	}
220: 	relToSprint, err := filepath.Rel(sprintRoot, full)
221: 	if err != nil || relToSprint == "." || strings.HasPrefix(relToSprint, "..") {
222: 		return "", NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "resolve path", "QA path is outside the selected sprint", err)
223: 	}
224: 	current := sprintRoot
225: 	for _, part := range strings.Split(filepath.Clean(relToSprint), string(filepath.Separator)) {
226: 		current = filepath.Join(current, part)
227: 		info, statErr := os.Lstat(current)
228: 		if errors.Is(statErr, fs.ErrNotExist) {
229: 			continue
230: 		}
231: 		if statErr != nil {
232: 			return "", NewQAError(QAErrorPersistenceFailure, "inspect path", "cannot inspect QA path", statErr)
233: 		}
234: 		if info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
235: 			return "", NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "resolve path", "QA path contains a symbolic link", nil)
236: 		}
237: 	}
238: 	return full, nil
239: }

242: 	path, err := store.StatePath()

251: 		return QAState{}, NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "load state", err.Error(), err)

256: 	for _, ref := range []*QAArtifactRef{state.Map, state.Synthesis, state.Adjudication, state.Issues, state.Assessment, state.CanonicalReport} {

258: 			continue

260: 		if err := store.verifyReference(*ref); err != nil {
261: 			return QAState{}, err
262: 		}
263: 	}
264: 	return state, nil
265: }

379: func (store QAStore) readStrictVersion(path, kind string, expectedVersion int, value any) error {
380: 	info, err := os.Lstat(path)
381: 	if err != nil {
382: 		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
383: 			return NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "load "+kind, kind+" is missing", err)
384: 		}
385: 		return NewQAError(QAErrorPersistenceFailure, "load "+kind, "cannot inspect QA file", err)
386: 	}
387: 	if !info.Mode().IsRegular() || info.Mode().Perm() != 0o600 {
388: 		return NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "load "+kind, "QA file must be a regular private 0600 file", nil)
389: 	}
390: 	file, err := os.Open(path)
391: 	if err != nil {
392: 		return NewQAError(QAErrorPersistenceFailure, "load "+kind, "cannot open QA file", err)
393: 	}
394: 	defer file.Close()
395: 	data, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(file, qaHardStateBytes+1))
396: 	if err != nil {
397: 		return NewQAError(QAErrorPersistenceFailure, "load "+kind, "cannot read QA file", err)
398: 	}
399: 	if len(data) > qaHardStateBytes {
400: 		return NewQAError(QAErrorBudgetExhausted, "load "+kind, "QA file exceeds the hard state limit", nil)
401: 	}
402: 	var header struct {
403: 		SchemaVersion int `json:"schema_version"`
404: 	}
405: 	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &header); err != nil {
406: 		return NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "load "+kind, "malformed QA JSON", err)
407: 	}
408: 	versionAccepted := header.SchemaVersion == expectedVersion
409: 	if kind == "state" && expectedVersion == 0 {
410: 		versionAccepted = header.SchemaVersion == QASchemaVersion || header.SchemaVersion == QAStateSchemaVersion
411: 	}
412: 	if !versionAccepted {
413: 		category := QAErrorUnknownSchema
414: 		if header.SchemaVersion == 0 {
415: 			category = QAErrorInvalidState
416: 		}
417: 		return NewQAError(category, "load "+kind, fmt.Sprintf("unsupported QA schema version %d", header.SchemaVersion), nil)
418: 	}
419: 	decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(data))
420: 	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
421: 	if err := decoder.Decode(value); err != nil {
422: 		return NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "load "+kind, "malformed or unknown QA field", err)
423: 	}
424: 	var trailing any
425: 	if err := decoder.Decode(&trailing); err == nil {
426: 		return NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "load "+kind, "multiple JSON values", nil)
427: 	} else if !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
428: 		return NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "load "+kind, "trailing QA JSON", err)
429: 	}
430: 	return nil
431: }

457: func (store QAStore) Publish(publication QAPublication, token QAWriterToken) (resultErr error) {
458: 	if err := store.checkWriter(token); err != nil {
459: 		return err
460: 	}
461: 	if publication.Evidence != nil {
462: 		publication.State.SchemaVersion = QAStateSchemaVersion
463: 	}
464: 	if err := ValidateQAState(publication.State); err != nil {
465: 		return NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "publish", err.Error(), err)
466: 	}
467: 	if publication.State.Project != store.sprint.Project || publication.State.Sprint != store.sprint.Slug {
468: 		return NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "publish", "QA state scope does not match the selected sprint", nil)
469: 	}
470: 	statePath, err := store.StatePath()
471: 	if err != nil {
472: 		return err
473: 	}
474: 	reportPath, err := store.resolve(QAReportRelPath(store.sprint))
475: 	if err != nil {
476: 		return err
477: 	}
478: 	flowPath, err := FlowStatePath(store.root, store.sprint)
479: 	if err != nil {
480: 		return err
481: 	}
482: 	snapshots, err := captureQACanonicalFiles(statePath, reportPath, flowPath)
483: 	if err != nil {
484: 		return NewQAError(QAErrorPersistenceFailure, "publish", "cannot snapshot canonical QA files", err)
485: 	}
486: 	canonicalStarted := false
487: 	defer func() {
488: 		if resultErr != nil && canonicalStarted {
489: 			if rollbackErr := restoreQACanonicalFiles(snapshots); rollbackErr != nil {
490: 				resultErr = errors.Join(resultErr, NewQAError(QAErrorPersistenceFailure, "publish rollback", "cannot restore prior canonical QA files", rollbackErr))
491: 			}
492: 		}
493: 	}()
494: 	if publication.Map != nil {
495: 		if err := ValidateQAMap(*publication.Map); err != nil {
496: 			return NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "publish map", err.Error(), err)
497: 		}
498: 		path, err := store.mapPath(publication.Map.SemanticAttemptID)
499: 		if err != nil {
500: 			return err
501: 		}
502: 		if err := store.checkWriter(token); err != nil {
503: 			return err
504: 		}
505: 		digest, err := store.writeRecord("map", path, publication.Map, true)
506: 		if err != nil {
507: 			return err
508: 		}
509: 		publication.State.Map = &QAArtifactRef{Path: QAMapRelPath(store.sprint, publication.Map.SemanticAttemptID), Digest: digest}
510: 		publication.State.CurrentAttemptID = publication.Map.SemanticAttemptID
511: 	}
512: 	sort.Slice(publication.Shards, func(i, j int) bool { return publication.Shards[i].ID < publication.Shards[j].ID })
513: 	for i := range publication.Shards {
514: 		shard := &publication.Shards[i]
515: 		if err := ValidateQAShard(*shard); err != nil {
516: 			return NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "publish shard", err.Error(), err)
517: 		}
518: 		path, err := store.shardPath(shard.AttemptID, shard.ID)
519: 		if err != nil {
520: 			return err
521: 		}
522: 		if err := store.checkWriter(token); err != nil {
523: 			return err
524: 		}

44: // VerificationBytes returns the retained private QA footprint without
45: // following symbolic links.
46: func (store QAStore) VerificationBytes() (int64, error) {
47: 	root, err := store.resolve(filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Join("projects", store.sprint.Project, "sprints", store.sprint.Slug, "verification")))
48: 	if err != nil {
49: 		return 0, err
50: 	}
51: 	var total int64
52: 	err = filepath.WalkDir(root, func(path string, entry fs.DirEntry, walkErr error) error {
53: 		if errors.Is(walkErr, fs.ErrNotExist) {
54: 			return nil
55: 		}
56: 		if walkErr != nil {
57: 			return walkErr
58: 		}
59: 		info, infoErr := entry.Info()
60: 		if infoErr != nil {
61: 			return infoErr
62: 		}
63: 		if info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
64: 			return NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "measure state", "QA state contains a symbolic link", nil)
65: 		}
66: 		if info.Mode().IsRegular() {
67: 			total += info.Size()
68: 		}
69: 		return nil
70: 	})
71: 	if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
72: 		return 0, nil
73: 	}
74: 	if err != nil {
75: 		return 0, NewQAError(QAErrorPersistenceFailure, "measure state", "cannot measure retained QA state", err)
76: 	}
77: 	return total, nil
78: }

80: // PruneAttempts keeps the newest bounded set plus the protected current
81: // semantic attempt. It removes only validated attempt directories.
82: func (store QAStore) PruneAttempts(protected string, retain int) error {
83: 	if retain <= 0 {
84: 		return NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "prune attempts", "retention limit must be positive", nil)
85: 	}
86: 	root, err := store.resolve(filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Join("projects", store.sprint.Project, "sprints", store.sprint.Slug, "verification", "attempts")))
87: 	if err != nil {
88: 		return err
89: 	}
90: 	entries, err := os.ReadDir(root)
91: 	if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
92: 		return nil
93: 	}
94: 	if err != nil {
95: 		return NewQAError(QAErrorPersistenceFailure, "prune attempts", "cannot list retained attempts", err)
96: 	}
97: 	type candidate struct {
98: 		name string
99: 		path string
100: 		mod  int64
101: 	}
102: 	values := make([]candidate, 0, len(entries))
103: 	for _, entry := range entries {
104: 		if !entry.IsDir() || !validQAIDKind(entry.Name(), "attempt") {
105: 			return NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "prune attempts", "attempt storage contains an invalid entry", nil)
106: 		}
107: 		info, infoErr := entry.Info()
108: 		if infoErr != nil || info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
109: 			return NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "prune attempts", "attempt storage contains an unsafe entry", infoErr)
110: 		}
111: 		values = append(values, candidate{name: entry.Name(), path: filepath.Join(root, entry.Name()), mod: info.ModTime().UnixNano()})
112: 	}
113: 	sort.Slice(values, func(i, j int) bool {
114: 		if values[i].mod == values[j].mod {
115: 			return values[i].name > values[j].name
116: 		}
117: 		return values[i].mod > values[j].mod
118: 	})
119: 	keep := map[string]bool{}
120: 	for _, value := range values {
121: 		if value.name == protected {
122: 			keep[value.name] = true
123: 			break
124: 		}
125: 	}
126: 	for _, value := range values {
127: 		if keep[value.name] || len(keep) < retain {
128: 			keep[value.name] = true
129: 			continue
130: 		}
131: 		if err := os.RemoveAll(value.path); err != nil {
132: 			return NewQAError(QAErrorPersistenceFailure, "prune attempts", "cannot remove an expired QA attempt", err)
133: 		}
134: 	}
135: 	return nil
136: }

211: func (store QAStore) resolve(rel string) (string, error) {
212: 	full, err := resolveSprintContained(store.root, store.sprint, rel)
213: 	if err != nil {
214: 		return "", NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "resolve path", "QA path escapes the selected sprint", err)
215: 	}
216: 	sprintRoot, err := resolveSprintContained(store.root, store.sprint, filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Join("projects", store.sprint.Project, "sprints", store.sprint.Slug)))
217: 	if err != nil {
218: 		return "", err
219: 	}
220: 	relToSprint, err := filepath.Rel(sprintRoot, full)
221: 	if err != nil || relToSprint == "." || strings.HasPrefix(relToSprint, "..") {
222: 		return "", NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "resolve path", "QA path is outside the selected sprint", err)
223: 	}
224: 	current := sprintRoot
225: 	for _, part := range strings.Split(filepath.Clean(relToSprint), string(filepath.Separator)) {
226: 		current = filepath.Join(current, part)
227: 		info, statErr := os.Lstat(current)
228: 		if errors.Is(statErr, fs.ErrNotExist) {
229: 			continue
230: 		}
231: 		if statErr != nil {
232: 			return "", NewQAError(QAErrorPersistenceFailure, "inspect path", "cannot inspect QA path", statErr)
233: 		}
234: 		if info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
235: 			return "", NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "resolve path", "QA path contains a symbolic link", nil)
236: 		}
237: 	}
238: 	return full, nil
239: }

241: func (store QAStore) LoadState() (QAState, error) {
242: 	path, err := store.StatePath()
243: 	if err != nil {
244: 		return QAState{}, err
245: 	}
246: 	var state QAState
247: 	if err := store.readStrictVersion(path, "state", 0, &state); err != nil {
248: 		return QAState{}, err
249: 	}
250: 	if err := ValidateQAState(state); err != nil {
251: 		return QAState{}, NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "load state", err.Error(), err)
252: 	}
253: 	if state.Project != store.sprint.Project || state.Sprint != store.sprint.Slug {
254: 		return QAState{}, NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "load state", "QA state scope does not match the selected sprint", nil)
255: 	}
256: 	for _, ref := range []*QAArtifactRef{state.Map, state.Synthesis, state.Adjudication, state.Issues, state.Assessment, state.CanonicalReport} {
257: 		if ref == nil {
258: 			continue
259: 		}
260: 		if err := store.verifyReference(*ref); err != nil {
261: 			return QAState{}, err
262: 		}
263: 	}
264: 	return state, nil
265: }

379: func (store QAStore) readStrictVersion(path, kind string, expectedVersion int, value any) error {
380: 	info, err := os.Lstat(path)
381: 	if err != nil {
382: 		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
383: 			return NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "load "+kind, kind+" is missing", err)
384: 		}
385: 		return NewQAError(QAErrorPersistenceFailure, "load "+kind, "cannot inspect QA file", err)
386: 	}
387: 	if !info.Mode().IsRegular() || info.Mode().Perm() != 0o600 {
388: 		return NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "load "+kind, "QA file must be a regular private 0600 file", nil)
389: 	}
390: 	file, err := os.Open(path)
391: 	if err != nil {
392: 		return NewQAError(QAErrorPersistenceFailure, "load "+kind, "cannot open QA file", err)
393: 	}
394: 	defer file.Close()
395: 	data, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(file, qaHardStateBytes+1))
396: 	if err != nil {
397: 		return NewQAError(QAErrorPersistenceFailure, "load "+kind, "cannot read QA file", err)
398: 	}
399: 	if len(data) > qaHardStateBytes {
400: 		return NewQAError(QAErrorBudgetExhausted, "load "+kind, "QA file exceeds the hard state limit", nil)
401: 	}
402: 	var header struct {
403: 		SchemaVersion int `json:"schema_version"`
404: 	}
405: 	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &header); err != nil {
406: 		return NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "load "+kind, "malformed QA JSON", err)
407: 	}
408: 	versionAccepted := header.SchemaVersion == expectedVersion
409: 	if kind == "state" && expectedVersion == 0 {
410: 		versionAccepted = header.SchemaVersion == QASchemaVersion || header.SchemaVersion == QAStateSchemaVersion
411: 	}
412: 	if !versionAccepted {
413: 		category := QAErrorUnknownSchema
414: 		if header.SchemaVersion == 0 {
415: 			category = QAErrorInvalidState
416: 		}
417: 		return NewQAError(category, "load "+kind, fmt.Sprintf("unsupported QA schema version %d", header.SchemaVersion), nil)
418: 	}
419: 	decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(data))
420: 	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
421: 	if err := decoder.Decode(value); err != nil {
422: 		return NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "load "+kind, "malformed or unknown QA field", err)
423: 	}
424: 	var trailing any
425: 	if err := decoder.Decode(&trailing); err == nil {
426: 		return NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "load "+kind, "multiple JSON values", nil)
427: 	} else if !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
428: 		return NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "load "+kind, "trailing QA JSON", err)
429: 	}
430: 	return nil
431: }

457: func (store QAStore) Publish(publication QAPublication, token QAWriterToken) (resultErr error) {
458: 	if err := store.checkWriter(token); err != nil {
459: 		return err
460: 	}
461: 	if publication.Evidence != nil {
462: 		publication.State.SchemaVersion = QAStateSchemaVersion
463: 	}
464: 	if err := ValidateQAState(publication.State); err != nil {
465: 		return NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "publish", err.Error(), err)
466: 	}
467: 	if publication.State.Project != store.sprint.Project || publication.State.Sprint != store.sprint.Slug {
468: 		return NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "publish", "QA state scope does not match the selected sprint", nil)
469: 	}
470: 	statePath, err := store.StatePath()
471: 	if err != nil {
472: 		return err
473: 	}
474: 	reportPath, err := store.resolve(QAReportRelPath(store.sprint))
475: 	if err != nil {
476: 		return err
477: 	}
478: 	flowPath, err := FlowStatePath(store.root, store.sprint)
479: 	if err != nil {
480: 		return err
481: 	}
482: 	snapshots, err := captureQACanonicalFiles(statePath, reportPath, flowPath)
483: 	if err != nil {
484: 		return NewQAError(QAErrorPersistenceFailure, "publish", "cannot snapshot canonical QA files", err)
485: 	}
486: 	canonicalStarted := false
487: 	defer func() {
488: 		if resultErr != nil && canonicalStarted {
489: 			if rollbackErr := restoreQACanonicalFiles(snapshots); rollbackErr != nil {
490: 				resultErr = errors.Join(resultErr, NewQAError(QAErrorPersistenceFailure, "publish rollback", "cannot restore prior canonical QA files", rollbackErr))
491: 			}
492: 		}
493: 	}()
494: 	if publication.Map != nil {
495: 		if err := ValidateQAMap(*publication.Map); err != nil {
496: 			return NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "publish map", err.Error(), err)
497: 		}
498: 		path, err := store.mapPath(publication.Map.SemanticAttemptID)
499: 		if err != nil {
500: 			return err
501: 		}
502: 		if err := store.checkWriter(token); err != nil {
503: 			return err
504: 		}
505: 		digest, err := store.writeRecord("map", path, publication.Map, true)
506: 		if err != nil {
507: 			return err
508: 		}
509: 		publication.State.Map = &QAArtifactRef{Path: QAMapRelPath(store.sprint, publication.Map.SemanticAttemptID), Digest: digest}
510: 		publication.State.CurrentAttemptID = publication.Map.SemanticAttemptID
511: 	}
512: 	sort.Slice(publication.Shards, func(i, j int) bool { return publication.Shards[i].ID < publication.Shards[j].ID })
513: 	for i := range publication.Shards {
514: 		shard := &publication.Shards[i]
515: 		if err := ValidateQAShard(*shard); err != nil {
516: 			return NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "publish shard", err.Error(), err)
517: 		}
518: 		path, err := store.shardPath(shard.AttemptID, shard.ID)
519: 		if err != nil {
520: 			return err
521: 		}
522: 		if err := store.checkWriter(token); err != nil {
523: 			return err
524: 		}
525: 		if _, err := store.writeRecord("shard", path, shard, false); err != nil {
526: 			return err
527: 		}
528: 	}
529: 	if publication.Synthesis != nil {
530: 		if err := ValidateQASynthesis(*publication.Synthesis, MaximumQABudgets()); err != nil {
531: 			return NewQAError(QAErrorInvalidState, "publish synthesis", err.Error(), err)
532: 		}
533: 		path, err := store.synthesisPath(publication.Synthesis.AttemptID)
534: 		if err != nil {
535: 			return err
536: 		}
537: 		if err := store.checkWriter(token); err != nil {
538: 			return err
539: 		}
540: 		digest, err := store.writeRecord("synthesis", path, publication.Synthesis, false)
541: 		if err != nil {
542: 			return err
543: 		}
